title: Teammanager Zorg, De Bolder en De Ruyterstraat, Huizen
description:
Ben jij een inspirerende, zelfstandige en vakbekwame teammanager die stevig in de schoenen staat, oog heeft voor mensen en energie krijgt van het verder ontwikkelen van zorgteams? Voor Vivium Zorggroep zoeken wij vanwege tijdelijke uitval een Teammanager Zorg voor De Ruyterstraat en De Bolder in Huizen.

Wij zijn per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Teammanager Zorg voor 24 tot 36 uur per week.

‘‘Goed leiderschap begint met oprechte aandacht voor mensen en vertrouwen in hun kwaliteiten. Door richting te geven en ruimte te bieden, bouw je samen aan sterke teams en goede zorg.”

Wat ga je doen?

Als Teammanager Zorg heb je een veelzijdige en betekenisvolle functie waarin je leidinggeeft aan verschillende zorgteams op de locaties De Ruyterstraat en De Bolder in Huizen. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers en zorgt voor de juiste randvoorwaarden, zodat zij met plezier hun werk doen en bewoners de aandacht en zorg krijgen die zij verdienen.

Je dag bestaat uit het afstemmen van de personeelsplanning, contact met medewerkers en collega’s, het voeren van gesprekken en het oplossen van dagelijkse uitdagingen. Daarnaast werk je aan teamontwikkeling, vertaal je jaarplannen naar concrete doelen en bewaak je de kwaliteit van zorg, personele bezetting en bedrijfsvoering. Je stelt prioriteiten, houdt overzicht en schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende verantwoordelijkheden.

Je stimuleert medewerkers om hun kwaliteiten te benutten, eigenaarschap te tonen en samen te werken aan een prettige, professionele werkomgeving. Daarbij combineer je daadkracht en duidelijkheid met coaching, vertrouwen en oprechte aandacht voor mensen.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega-teammanagers, planners, de locatiemanager en andere disciplines om de continuïteit en kwaliteit van zorg te waarborgen.

De Bolder is een gezellig en kleurrijk huis in het centrum van Huizen, waar 151 bewoners met dementie in verschillende woonvormen wonen. Persoonlijke aandacht, een fijne leefomgeving en passende activiteiten staan centraal. Ook op De Ruyterstraat is vertrouwde, goede zorg het uitgangspunt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt een relevante zorgopleiding gevolgd;

  • Het bezit van een managementdiploma op HBO-niveau is een pre, en je hebt ervaring in het leidinggeven van zorg teams;

  • Je hebt affiniteit met de (psychogeriatrische) ouderenzorg;

  • Je werkt methodisch en projectmatig, je hebt bedrijfskundig inzicht (of de wens om dit te ontwikkelen);

  • Je bent begripvol en meegaand, maar kiest ook bewust wanneer je ‘nee’ zegt.

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

  • Salaris van € 3.592,96 tot € 5413,38 per maand bij een fulltime dienstverband (CAO VVT, FWG 55);

  • Behalve vakantiegeld in het voorjaar, ontvang je ook een eindejaarsuitkering in november;

  • Mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en uitdaging, bijvoorbeeld via onze Vivium Academy.

We zijn trots op #teamvivium en dat laten we graag blijken!
Als Vivium-collega profiteer je daarom van fijne extra’s:

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding die beter is dan de CAO;

  • Korting op leuke uitstapjes en producten;

  • Belastingvoordeel op bijvoorbeeld een e-bike, fiets, elektrische scooter en laptop/tablet;

  • En ook op een fitnessabonnement en waardebonnen van , Fashioncheque en Coolblue;

En nog veel meer slimme extra’s.
Check de Vivium Voordelen, de keuze is aan jou!

Enthousiast?

Mooi: we horen graag van je! Heb je eerst nog vragen, of wil je meer informatie over deze Teammanager-vacature? Neem dan contact op met afdeling Recruitment via 035- 6924 039 of werkenbij@vivium.nl.
Ben je er al uit? Fijn: druk op de sollicitatie knop en vertel ons kort wat je als Teammanager bij ons wilt toevoegen.

title: Technisch specialist Volkswagen Audi I Oud-Gastel
description:
Werken als Technisch Specialist bij Audi in Oud Gastel? In een moderne werkplaats met de nieuwste gereedschappen, technologieën en diagnoseapparatuur ga jij aan de slag met uiteenlopende technische uitdagingen. Met je eigen iPad, ODIS-testkast en volop mogelijkheden om jezelf via importeur Pon verder te ontwikkelen, blijf jij op de hoogte van de nieuwste technieken. Werken bij een mobiliteitsorganisatie met leuke personeelsevents en waar het gezamenlijke resultaat telt? Welkom bij Van den Udenhout!

Hier word jij blij van:

  • Een goed salaris

  • Een startbonus van € 1.000 netto, uitbetaald na 6 maanden in dienst

  • Snel zicht op een vast contract

  • 192 verlofuren

  • Gratis bedrijfsfysio

  • Een flexibele werkweek van 24 tot 40 uur, in overleg af te stemmen

  • Een persoonlijk opleidingsplan met trainingen via Pon

  • Een moderne werkplaats met de nieuwste gereedschappen, technologieën en een klusregeling

  • Je eigen iPad en ODIS-testkast

  • Volop doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen de VAG-merken

  • Brabantse gezelligheid in een betrokken team

  • Leuke personeelsevents binnen een grote mobiliteitsorganisatie

Wij zijn blij met:

  • Jouw ervaring als Automonteur | Eerste Autotechnicus | Technisch Specialist

  • Jouw kennis van moderne voertuigtechniek, elektronica en diagnoses

  • Jouw motivatie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen de nieuwste autotechnieken

Een dag als Technisch Specialist

  • Je begint de werkdag in de Audi-werkplaats in Oud Gastel met het doornemen van de planning op je eigen iPad. Vandaag staat er onder andere een auto met een complexe motorstoring op je te wachten.

  • Met behulp van de ODIS-diagnoseapparatuur onderzoek je de storing, achterhaal je de oorzaak en bepaal je welke werkzaamheden nodig zijn.

  • Je overlegt met de voorman over de benodigde onderdelen en gaat vervolgens zelfstandig aan de slag met de technische reparatie.

  • Na de lunch staat er een auto klaar met een elektronische storing. Met jouw technische kennis en de nieuwste diagnoseapparatuur weet je het probleem te achterhalen.

  • Je controleert of de storing volledig is verholpen en verwerkt je werkzaamheden zorgvuldig in de digitale werkorder.

  • Naast je dagelijkse werkzaamheden krijg je volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Zo volg je regelmatig technische trainingen via Pon, bijvoorbeeld over elektrische modellen, hoogvoltsystemen en infotainment.

Profiel

Jij wordt blij van techniek en krijgt energie van het oplossen van complexe storingen. Of je nu ervaring hebt als automonteur, eerste autotechnicus of technisch specialist: jij wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en werkt graag met de nieuwste technieken van Audi.

  • Ervaring als automonteur, eerste autotechnicus of technisch specialist, bij voorkeur binnen een dealerbedrijf of universeel autobedrijf

  • Affiniteit met moderne voertuigtechniek, elektronica en het stellen van diagnoses

  • Zelfstandig en nauwkeurig kunnen werken en graag meedenken over technische oplossingen

  • Interesse in elektrische voertuigen, hoogvolttechniek en infotainmentsystemen

  • Bereidheid om trainingen te volgen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen

  • Graag werken in een betrokken team waar het gezamenlijke resultaat telt

Van den Udenhout als organisatie

Sinds onze oprichting in 1957 is Van den Udenhout uitgegroeid tot een van de grootste en meest vooruitstrevende mobiliteitsorganisaties van Zuid-Nederland. Vanuit onze vestigingen in Noord-Brabant bieden we verkoop en onderhoud van auto’s, aangevuld met mobiliteitsoplossingen zoals verhuur, lease, schadeherstel, bedrijfswageninbouw en (e-)bikes.

Wij zijn De Nieuwe Dealer voor Volkswagen, Audi, SEAT, Škoda, CUPRA en Volkswagen Bedrijfswagens met vestigingen in Best, Boxtel, Breda, Den Bosch, Eindhoven, Halsteren, Oss, Oud Gastel, Roosendaal en Veldhoven. Daarnaast hebben we een belang in diverse Porsche- en Bentley-dealerbedrijven in Brabant en Limburg, waaronder Porsche Centrum Brabant, Porsche Centrum Maastricht en Bentley Maastricht.

Werken bij Van den Udenhout betekent werken in een warme, ambitieuze Brabantse organisatie waar persoonlijke aandacht, groei en passie voor mobiliteit centraal staan. Samen met zo’n 1.000 collega’s bouwen we iedere dag aan de mobiliteit van morgen.

Contactinformatie

Interesse in een meeloopdag? Elke woensdag, donderdag, vrijdag en zaterdag organiseren we meeloopdagen van 10:00 tot 15:00 uur. Schrijf je in!

Meer weten? App met recruitment via 06-23364172 of mail naar werkenbij@udenhout.nl.

title: Global HR Associate
description:
Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company leveraging thermal satellite imagery and advanced geospatial intelligence to address some of the world’s most pressing challenges.

By combining proprietary satellite technology, Earth observation data, and advanced analytics, Hydrosat delivers actionable insights to customers across agriculture, water management, infrastructure, government, and defense. As a rapidly growing, internationally operating company, Hydrosat is expanding its satellite capabilities, commercial activities, and government partnerships.

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Global HR Associate to support our growing international team. In this role, you will provide essential administrative and operational support to our HR function, primarily focusing on US operations while assisting with HR activities across the globe.

You will be responsible for coordinating day-to-day HR processes, maintaining accurate employee records, supporting onboarding activities, and ensuring that administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time. This is a hands-on, predominantly administrative position suited to someone who genuinely enjoys structured, detail-oriented work, takes pride in accuracy, and can independently manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, international environment. You will work closely with our HR team and serve as an important point of coordination for employees, managers, and internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to the global HR team, with a primary focus on US operations.

  • Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring documentation, communications, and administrative requirements are completed accurately and on time.

  • Prepare, organize, and maintain HR documentation, including offer letters, employment agreements, employee records, and other HR-related correspondence.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee information across HR systems, databases, and internal records.

  • Support recruitment administration, including interview coordination, candidate communication, and preparation of hiring documentation.

  • Monitor shared HR inboxes, respond to routine inquiries, and ensure timely follow-up or escalation when necessary.

  • Track administrative deadlines, maintain organized documentation, and follow up on outstanding actions to ensure timely completion.

  • Support the coordination of virtual employee engagement activities, internal events, and HR communications.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Previous experience in an HR Coordinator, HR Assistant, HR Operations Associate, or similar administrative role.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a meticulous approach to accuracy, consistency, and completeness when handling employee records, documentation, and repetitive administrative tasks.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to independently prioritize multiple tasks, manage competing deadlines, and consistently deliver accurate work on time.

  • A proactive, dependable, and responsive working style, with clear, professional communication and the ability to follow through on commitments without constant supervision in a remote environment.

  • Practical experience supporting US HR administration, including employee documentation, onboarding processes, and HR record management.

  • High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential employee information.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and Microsoft SharePoint.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with employees, managers, and stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining responsiveness and effective collaboration with colleagues across different time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience supporting HR operations in a multinational or geographically distributed organization.

  • Familiarity with HR information systems (HRIS), applicant tracking systems (ATS), or other HR administration tools.

  • Experience supporting HR processes across multiple countries or jurisdictions.

  • Previous experience coordinating virtual employee engagement activities or internal events.

Employment Eligibility Verification (E-Verify)

Hydrosat participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization in the United States. For additional information about E-Verify, please visit .

title: Automation Quality Analyst
description:
Role: Automation Quality Analyst
Location: India, Remote
Experience: 2–4 Years

Algoworks

About the Company
Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and India. We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable results.

For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful business outcomes. Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision. Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem-solving and continuous improvement.

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

Follow the video below to know about us!
Clipchamp

Role Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented and enthusiastic Android QA Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team. The candidate will be responsible for validating Android applications across devices and operating system versions, executing functional and regression tests, identifying defects, and contributing to automation and continuous quality improvement.
The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in software testing concepts, basic Android and Linux knowledge, and an eagerness to learn automation tools and modern Quality Engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities
1. Testing & Quality Assurance
  • Understand business requirements and user workflows and convert them into test scenarios and test cases.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing.
  • Execute test cases and report defects with sufficient evidence and reproduction steps.
  • Participate in release validation and quality certification activities.
  • Apply test design techniques such as Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis, Decision Tables, and State Transition Testing.

2. Android Application & Device Testing
  • Test Android applications on emulators and physical devices.
  • Validate application behaviour across different screen sizes and Android OS versions.
  • Capture screenshots, logs, videos, and test evidence.
  • Perform installation, upgrade, and compatibility testing.
  • Use Android Debug Bridge (ADB) for basic troubleshooting and diagnostics.
  • Review Logcat outputs and assist in defect root cause analysis.

3. Automation Engineering
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts.
  • Build reusable and data-driven automation test suites.
  • Contribute to automation framework development using industry-standard tools.
  • Execute automated test suites and analyse failures.
  • Create utilities and helper scripts for test data preparation and validation.

4. CI/CD & Reporting
  • Trigger and monitor automated test executions through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyse execution results and prepare quality reports.
  • Participate in release-readiness and quality-signoff activities.
  • Generate concise test execution summaries and release recommendations.

5. Continuous Learning & Collaboration
  • Learn modern Quality Engineering practices.
  • Explore AI-assisted testing techniques and tools.
  • Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and senior QA engineers.
  • Participate in training programs, hackathons, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions.

Required Technical Skills & Competencies
Software Testing Fundamentals
  • Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and Software Defect Lifecycle.
  • Understanding of functional and regression testing concepts.
  • Familiarity with test case design techniques.
Android Fundamentals
  • Basic understanding of Android applications and Android architecture.
  • Familiarity with APK installation and testing.
  • Understanding of Android emulators and mobile application testing concepts.
Linux Fundamentals
  • Basic Linux command-line knowledge.
  • Familiarity with file system navigation, log inspection, basic shell commands, and process monitoring.
Database Fundamentals
  • Basic understanding of relational databases.
  • Ability to write simple SQL queries using SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, and GROUP BY.
Version Control
  • Basic knowledge of Git.
  • Understanding of clone, commit, push, and pull request concepts.

Must-Have Skills
  • Software testing fundamentals.
  • Functional and regression testing.
  • Android application testing.
  • Test case design and defect reporting.
  • Basic Linux command-line knowledge.
  • Basic SQL queries.
  • Git fundamentals.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.

Good to Have Skills
  • Python programming.
  • Robot Framework.
  • Appium.
  • CI/CD exposure.
  • AI Foundation.

Desired Attributes
  • Passionate about software quality and testing.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving thinker.
  • Curious and eager to learn new technologies.
  • Detail-oriented and quality-focused.
  • Good team player with strong communication skills.
  • Self-motivated and willing to take ownership.

Interview Process
2–3 rounds of discussion.

title: Utility Operator
description:
About NWH


Northwest Hardwoods is a leading manufacturer of hardwood lumber in North America and a fully integrated global supplier serving the furniture, cabinet, molding, and millwork industries. Our plant team brings together the sawmill operations, production, grading, kiln drying, surfacing, packaging, and quality control to transform hardwood logs into high-quality lumber products for customers around the world. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible contribution to a global operation.


At Northwest Hardwoods (NWH), you’ll play a critical role in keeping our sawmill and manufacturing operations running safely, reliably, and efficiently. As a Utility Operator you will be the jack of all trades within our facility. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible contribution to a global operation by keeping the equipment and people behind our products running at their best.


Why This Role Matters:


This position is all about safety, reliability, and attention to detail. You’ll be responsible for operating the wood chipper, debarker, and trimmer, as well as filling in as a Green Chain puller. This role is important and will be considered "the-jack-of-all-trades" of the plant.

  • Maintain a strong safety-first mindset, follow all safety procedures, and use required PPE, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and fall protection. Remain alert when working around moving equipment, machinery, and material flow.
  • Be trained or willing to learn to safely operate the Chipper, Debarker, Trimmers, Edgers, and other mill equipment. Learn proper operating procedures, make safe decisions, and operate equipment efficiently.
  • Monitor the flow of logs, lumber, cants, slabs, and edger strips throughout the mill. Identify material blockages, equipment issues, and quality concerns, and communicate with the appropriate personnel to maintain safe, efficient production and product quality.
  • Perform routine equipment inspections and maintenance, including greasing bearings, monitoring component wear, changing Chipper knives when trained, cleaning equipment, and reporting maintenance concerns.
  • Maintain clean and organized work areas by removing debris, trash, bark buildup, and material obstructions. Perform general cleanup and other groundskeeping duties as needed.
  • Communicate and work effectively with coworkers, operators, maintenance personnel, and supervisors. Be willing to cross-train, fill in at different mill positions, and assist with other duties as needed.
  • Maintain reliable attendance and arrive on time, ready to work. Ensure assigned equipment is prepared for operation before production begins.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
The Technical Support Engineer position is based in Jakarta, Indonesia, and will play a key role in providing technical and sales support for Indonesia, with additional support across the APAC region as and when required. The role is responsible for understanding client requirements, recommending appropriate technical solutions, and ensuring the efficient execution of technical activities and operations.

This role requires a strong technical background, particularly in downhole tools, combined with excellent communication and organizational skills.

Responsibilities

Technical Support:
  • Install and Configure Equipment: Assist clients in selecting and setting up appropriate tools and equipment, ensuring they are tailored to specific operational needs.
  • Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution: Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by analyzing feedback, collaborating with other engineers, and utilizing advanced troubleshooting techniques. Ensure that all issues are documented and tracked for future reference.
  • Non-Conformance Reporting and Investigation: Conduct investigations into equipment and process failures, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions. Ensure that investigations are thoroughly documented and that all findings are communicated both internally and externally. This involves:
    • NCR Creation: Documenting any deviation from expected performance or quality standards in a detailed NCR. This includes gathering all relevant data, witness statements, and preliminary findings.
    • Investigation and Root Cause Analysis: Conducting a detailed investigation to identify the root cause of the non-conformance. Utilize tools such as Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) or Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to ensure a comprehensive understanding of the issue.
    • Corrective and Preventive Actions: Developing and implementing corrective actions to address the root cause, as well as preventive measures to avoid recurrence. This may involve changes to design, process, or materials used.
    • Close-out of Reports: Ensuring that all NCRs are closed out in a timely manner, with all corrective and preventive actions completed and verified. The close-out process should be documented, and any necessary updates to procedures or standards should be made.
    • Internal and External Reporting: Reporting the findings and close-out of NCRs to relevant internal stakeholders, including management and quality teams, as well as external parties such as clients or regulatory bodies as required.
  • Product Development Support: Collaborate with Product Champions, Design Engineers, and R&D teams to facilitate the successful release and deployment of new products, ensuring all technical bulletins are accurately communicated to the APAC team.
  • Technical Focal Point: Act as the primary technical point of contact for all company product lines, providing expertise and guidance to both internal teams and clients.


Operations Support:
  • Onsite Support: Provide onshore and offshore operational support, including emergency maintenance of equipment and on-site technical assistance as needed.
  • Project Management: Coordinate with the Sales and Operations teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, with thorough operational planning for professional execution.
  • Equipment Investigations: Conduct detailed investigations into equipment performance, addressing any non-conformance issues and ensuring that lessons learned are disseminated across relevant teams.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 8–10 years of relevant industry experience in well completion and intervention services.
  • Good technical knowledge and understanding of downhole tools and completion systems.
  • Experience working with 3D CAD software would be an added advantage.
  • High degree of accuracy and strong attention to detail.
  • Well-organized, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Strong service-oriented mindset with a proactive and customer-focused approach.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English, with effective communication skills.

title: Site Supervisor (Escondido)
description:
Reports To: Divisional Director of Early Childhood Education and Compliance

Department: Early Childhood Education

Classification: [Exempt/Non-Exempt]

Location: San Diego, CA


Position Definition

Under the direct supervision of the Divisional Director of Early Childhood Education and Compliance, the Site Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day leadership, administration, supervision, regulatory compliance, and overall operational effectiveness of an assigned Heartbeat Music & Performing Arts Academy (HBMPAA) early childhood education site. The Site Supervisor is accountable for maintaining a safe, nurturing, developmentally appropriate, and compliant educational environment for children from infancy through kindergarten. This position is responsible for ensuring that site operations consistently meet applicable requirements established by the California Department of Social Services, Community Care Licensing Division; California Department of Education (CDE) requirements applicable to funded programs; Title 5; Title 22; and all other applicable federal, state, local, licensing, funding, and HBMPAA requirements. The Site Supervisor provides direct leadership and oversight to Teachers, Teaching Assistants, Volunteers, Interns, and other assigned site personnel. This position is expected to maintain current knowledge of applicable regulatory requirements, identify and immediately address deficiencies, hold employees accountable for performance and conduct, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained. The Site Supervisor also serves as a member of the enrollment team and supports enrollment, family engagement, program quality, and student success. When designated by leadership, the Site Supervisor serves as the primary on-site contact for Community Care Licensing representatives and participates in licensing visits, inspections, audits, and corrective-action activities.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Site Leadership and Regulatory Compliance

  • Provide direct leadership and oversight of daily site operations and ensure the program operates in accordance with applicable Title 5, Title 22, licensing, funding, and HBMPAA requirements.
  • Maintain current working knowledge of laws, regulations, licensing standards, funding requirements, and organizational policies applicable to the assigned program and site.
  • Ensure required staff-to-child ratios and supervision requirements are maintained at all times.
  • Maintain a safe, sanitary, organized, nurturing, and developmentally appropriate environment for children, employees, families, and visitors.
  • Conduct routine site reviews and inspections to identify potential licensing, health, safety, operational, or program deficiencies.
  • Take immediate action when a compliance or safety concern is identified. The Site Supervisor is responsible for addressing the concern, communicating expectations, initiating corrective action, verifying completion, and monitoring the issue to ensure sustained compliance.
  • Ensure required licenses, notices, emergency information, postings, inspection records, and other regulatory documentation are current and properly maintained.
  • Maintain site readiness for announced and unannounced licensing, funding, health, safety, and organizational inspections or audits.
  • Immediately escalate serious licensing, child safety, health, employee conduct, or regulatory concerns to appropriate leadership.
  • Serve as an on-site representative during licensing visits and inspections when designated by leadership and ensure identified deficiencies are addressed within established deadlines.

2. Staff Supervision, Performance, and Accountability

  • Provide direct supervision, direction, coaching, and performance management for Teachers, Teaching Assistants, Volunteers, Interns, and other assigned site personnel.
  • Clearly communicate job expectations and ensure employees follow HBMPAA policies, classroom procedures, licensing requirements, safety standards, and leadership directives.
  • Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, reliability, conduct, classroom performance, supervision practices, and compliance with assigned responsibilities.
  • Address employee performance, attendance, conduct, safety, or compliance concerns promptly and consistently in coordination with Human Resources and appropriate leadership.
  • Hold employees accountable for failure to meet established performance, conduct, attendance, safety, or regulatory expectations.
  • Document coaching, performance concerns, attendance issues, policy violations, and other matters requiring formal follow-up in accordance with HBMPAA procedures.
  • Conduct employee performance evaluations at least every six months or as otherwise required by HBMPAA.
  • Evaluate employee performance using established measures, which may include:
    • Desired Results Developmental Profile (DRDP) outcomes;
    • Parent Satisfaction Survey results;
    • kindergarten readiness and student-development measures;
    • attendance, punctuality, and reliability;
    • documented callouts affecting classroom ratios, coverage, or operations;
    • classroom management and student engagement;
    • compliance with licensing and safety requirements;
    • completion and accuracy of required documentation; and
    • overall job performance and adherence to HBMPAA standards.
  • Identify training and development needs and provide or coordinate appropriate coaching, mentoring, and professional development.
  • Model professional conduct, accountability, effective communication, and appropriate interactions with children, families, employees, and visitors.

3. Child Supervision, Education, and Program Quality

  • Ensure children receive appropriate care, supervision, education, and developmental support throughout the program day.
  • Monitor classrooms and program areas regularly to ensure active supervision and compliance with established child-safety practices.
  • Intervene immediately when unsafe, inappropriate, or noncompliant practices are observed.
  • Ensure curriculum and instructional practices are developmentally appropriate and aligned with HBMPAA program objectives and applicable early childhood education standards.
  • Monitor completion and accuracy of student assessments, including DRDP documentation and other required developmental measures.
  • Ensure individualized learning goals are informed by assessments, observations, developmental needs, and family input.
  • Support Teachers in implementing appropriate classroom management and positive guidance strategies.
  • Monitor student progress and kindergarten readiness and implement improvement strategies when program outcomes do not meet established expectations.

4. Family and Community Engagement

  • Develop and maintain professional, respectful, and collaborative relationships with parents, guardians, families, and community partners.
  • Ensure families receive timely and appropriate communication regarding student progress, classroom activities, program expectations, incidents, and other relevant matters.
  • Conduct or oversee parent/guardian conferences regarding student development, progress, goals, behavioral concerns, and kindergarten readiness.
  • Respond professionally and promptly to parent/guardian questions, concerns, and complaints and escalate significant matters when appropriate.
  • Maintain confidentiality of student, family, and employee information in accordance with applicable laws and HBMPAA policies.
  • Participate in enrollment activities and support efforts to maintain appropriate program enrollment.

5. Health, Safety, and Emergency Preparedness

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable health, sanitation, child supervision, food safety, emergency preparedness, and injury-prevention requirements.
  • Ensure required daily child wellness and health observations are completed and documented as applicable.
  • Maintain emergency plans, emergency supplies, evacuation procedures, and required emergency documentation.
  • Ensure employees understand and follow emergency procedures and participate in required drills and safety training.
  • Immediately address and report suspected child abuse or neglect, injuries, safety hazards, licensing violations, or other serious incidents in accordance with mandated reporting obligations and HBMPAA procedures.
  • Ensure incidents involving children or employees are appropriately documented, reported, investigated, and escalated when required.

6. Administrative and Operational Management

  • Maintain complete, accurate, organized, and timely student, employee, attendance, licensing, enrollment, compliance, and program records.
  • Ensure required documentation is completed accurately and submitted within established deadlines.
  • Review site records routinely to identify missing, expired, inaccurate, or incomplete documentation and ensure deficiencies are corrected.
  • Utilize required daily, weekly, and monthly site compliance checklists and other monitoring tools established by HBMPAA.
  • Review emergency binders, employee and student files, licensing documentation, staff credentials, required postings, program records, and other assigned compliance materials.
  • Monitor classroom materials, instructional supplies, equipment, and other site resources and ensure responsible use of organizational funds and property.
  • Coordinate staffing and classroom coverage to maintain required ratios and minimize disruption to program operations.
  • Maintain consistent communication with the Divisional Director of Early Childhood Education and Compliance and other designated leadership regarding site performance, staffing, compliance, safety, and operational concerns.

7. Continuous Improvement and Accountability

  • Monitor program performance and implement corrective and continuous-improvement strategies when deficiencies or opportunities are identified.
  • Review assessment results, family feedback, attendance trends, classroom observations, compliance findings, and other program data to identify areas requiring improvement.
  • Develop and implement action plans when site or employee performance does not meet established standards.
  • Follow through on identified concerns until corrective actions have been completed and sustained.
  • Participate in organizational audits, compliance reviews, leadership meetings, professional development, and quality-improvement initiatives.
  • Perform other duties reasonably related to the position as assigned by HBMPAA leadership.

title: INTERSHIP Implicit Neural Representation for Lake & River Floodplain Topography
description:
The TPA service of the Data Campus has developed a 3D representation system for the state evolution of lakes/reservoirs and river reaches using SWOT time series. This includes estimating 3D bathymetry, water fill level, water surface area, volume changes, and their associated uncertainties by leveraging implicit neural representation techniques. This type of representation accounts for measurement uncertainties at both the input and output of the model, as well as the efficient large-scale processing of SWOT time series.

The objective of the internship will be to integrate the contributions of new satellite sensors and data sources into the implicit network:

  • SWOT KaRIn interferometric SAR images (Single Look Complex) and/or derived point clouds

  • Sentinel-1 SAR images (SLC and/or GRD)

  • Sentinel-2 L2A (optical imagery)

  • Sentinel-3 / Sentinel-6 / SWOT Nadir (Doppler altimetry)

The envisioned approaches may build upon existing literature in image and signal processing, including fields outside of remote sensing such as Bayesian methods, deformable models, random fields, and optimal transport


Profile

  • Final-year student in an engineering school or Master's degree, specializing in computer science, applied mathematics, or image and signal processing.

  • Strong knowledge of image processing, applied mathematics, and programming (preferably Python) is required.

  • Skills in remote sensing and the ability to develop in a Linux environment would be an asset.

  • Prior knowledge of hydrology is not required.

  • The candidate should demonstrate strong organizational skills in their daily work.

Apply today and help us create communities residents are proud to call home.

  • Building a Community: Be the face of Decathlon in Seberang Jaya. You’ll be a key advisor to a local community of fitness enthusiasts, students, and families gearing up for their next big adventure.


The Role: Your Day-to-Day Mission

As a Sports Advisor, your mission is simple: ensure every customer leaves "satisfied or satisfied."

You will be the face of Decathlon, bringing your expertise and enthusiasm to:

  • Be a Sports Coach: Share your passion! Greet customers warmly and offer expert advice on products, helping them find the perfect gear for their sport, even suggesting new activities.

title: Reisleiding 2027
description:
Maak van jouw werk een zonnig avontuur: word reisleider bij Corendon!

Zon, enthousiaste gasten en geen dag die hetzelfde is. Klinkt je dat goed in de oren? Dan zoeken we jou!

Voor onze lokale agenten op verschillende Europese vakantiebestemmingen zijn we op zoek naar enthousiaste reisleiders die vanaf april 2027 onze gasten een onvergetelijke vakantie willen bezorgen. Je bent beschikbaar tot en met oktober 2027 en klaar voor een seizoen vol afwisseling, nieuwe ontmoetingen en mooie ervaringen.

Jouw rol: hét gezicht van Corendon
Als reisleider ben jij hét aanspreekpunt voor onze gasten op hun vakantiebestemming. Van een warm welkom op de luchthaven tot het oplossen van een onverwacht probleem: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze gasten zich welkom voelen en volop kunnen genieten van hun vakantie.

Je bent gastvrij, denkt in oplossingen en houdt ook op drukke momenten het hoofd koel. Met jouw positieve energie maak je het verschil. Geen dag is hetzelfde en juist die afwisseling maakt jouw werk zo leuk!

Wat zijn je voornaamste werkzaamheden?

  • Begeleiding geven op de luchthaven, bij zowel aankomst als bij vertrek;

  • Informatiebijeenkomsten geven in de accommodaties;

  • Bezoekuren houden in de accommodaties;

  • Problemen en klachten oplossen;

  • Excursies en lokale autohuur verkopen;

  • Het verrichten van diverse administratieve werkzaamheden.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris tussen € 700 en € 1.200 netto per maand, afhankelijk van de bestemming, exclusief commissies;

  • Woonruimte op je bestemming; op de meeste bestemmingen wordt (gedeelde) woonruimte voor je geregeld;

  • Een goede voorbereiding: vóór de start van het seizoen volg je een volledig verzorgde driedaagse training. Woon je op grote afstand, dan vergoeden we twee hotelovernachtingen;

  • Een terugvlucht na het seizoen: heb je het seizoen positief afgerond, dan verzorgen wij je terugvlucht;

  • Commissies: op de verkoop van o.a. excursies tussen de 3% - 10%

  • Vervoer op bestemming: afhankelijk van de bestemming is er eventueel een vervoersmiddel beschikbaar;

  • Een tablet in bruikleen waarmee je jouw (administratieve) werkzaamheden kunt uitvoeren;

  • Vakantievoordeel voor jou én je omgeving: ook je gezin, familie en vrienden profiteren van korting op Corendon-vakanties.

  • Een seizoen als reisleider is niet alleen een mooie kans om werkervaring op te doen, maar ook om jezelf te ontwikkelen, nieuwe mensen te leren kennen en een bestemming écht te beleven.

Let op, je komt in dienst bij onze lokale agent op de bestemming. Daarom werk je onder een lokaal contract met de daarbij behorende arbeidsvoorwaarden

Wat neem jij mee?

  • Je bent minimaal 18 jaar;

  • Je hebt minimaal mbo-denk- en werkniveau. Een toeristische opleiding én ervaring als reisleider zijn mooi meegenomen;

  • Je bent servicegericht, klantvriendelijk en sterk in het oplossen van problemen;

  • Je beschikt over goede communicatieve en commerciële vaardigheden;

  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar voelt je ook thuis in een team;

  • Je bent stressbestendig, betrouwbaar en flexibel;

  • Je hebt geen typische 9-tot-5-mentaliteit en bent bereid om te werken wanneer dat nodig is;

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Beheersing van het Frans en/of Duits is een pré.

Zie jij jezelf al werken op een zonnige vakantiebestemming, waar gastvrijheid, afwisseling en nieuwe ervaringen samenkomen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Solliciteren kan tot en met 3 januari 2027. Stuur ons je motivatiebrief en cv en vertel waarom jij onze nieuwe reisleider bent.

Uiterlijk 8 januari 2027 laten we je weten of je wordt uitgenodigd voor een sollicitatiegesprek. De gesprekken vinden plaats op dinsdag 12 januari en woensdag 13 januari 2027. De gesprekken zullen plaatsvinden op ons hoofdkantoor in Badhoevedorp.

Bekijk onze recruitmentvideo via onderstaande link en ontdek hoe het is om te werken als reisleider bij Corendon. Is dit jouw volgende avontuur?

Heb je nog vragen n.a.v. deze vacature? Neem gerust contact met ons op, we helpen je graag verder!

Afdeling Reisleiding
Telefoon: +31 23 530 75 97
Bereikbaar: maandag tot en met vrijdag, van 08.30 tot 17.00 uur
E-mail: reisleiding@corendon.nl

title: People Specialist (German Speaking)
description:
What you will do
Hi, we are Swapfiets! 👋 Welcome to the world of worry-free biking! We are providing members an all-inclusive bike subscription with free repairs and maintenance and lead the movement to more liveable cities.

At Swapfiets, we've built a business on a simple idea: give people a reliable way to get around, and take away the hassle. Over 250,000 members across Europe trust us to keep them rolling. Behind that promise is a People & Culture team that keeps our organisation running just as smoothly, and that's where you come in.

We're looking for a People Specialist who knows German labour law inside out, keeps HR administration tight, and doesn't wait to be asked before spotting a problem and fixing it. 🚲 🚀

How you pedal us forward:
  • Own HR administration and payrolling for Germany, ensuring accuracy and timely execution at every step.
  • Be the knowledge owner for German labour law, proactively tracking changes, translating them into practice, and keeping the business compliant.
  • Advise employees and managers on local HR topics, legislation, and Swapfiets policy.
  • Handle individual employee matters and manage communication with external parties: Tax authorities, payroll providers, unions and employer associations.
  • Review and improve HR processes and systems (we work with HiBob and Remote) to keep things running efficiently.
  • Take end-to-end responsibility for People Operations in Germany. Support, guide and coach your People Specialist colleagues, coordinate HR projects, and act as a proactive challenger and advisor to our Centers of Excellence.
  • Stakeholder Management: Act as a liaison with country managers, Finance, Tech/ Data teams and external stakeholders to maximize your impact.

The gear you need:
  • Fluent in German and English.
  • A Bachelor's degree, preferably in HRM, Law, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in an HR operations role.
  • Solid, up-to-date knowledge of German labour law, and the drive to keep it that way.
  • A track record in accurate, structured HR administration; you get the details right without being asked twice.
  • A proactive mindset: you flag issues early, take ownership, and follow through.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, international environment where things don't always come with a manual

Benefits for a smooth ride:
  • Salary from €3184.- gross per month, depending on your experience, + 8% holiday allowance.
  • Your own Swapfiets (lend-lease) 🚲!
  • 32 vacation days for ample time off (that’s right, next to 25 vacation days you can use your 7 Swap days as you please).
  • A solid pension plan and a discount on your health insurance.
  • Mac or Windows laptop and phone allowance.
  • A challenging and rewarding role with significant responsibility and friendly colleagues.
  • Travel allowance (if you live more than 11 km away from the office, otherwise you’ll just use your Swapfiets, right.. 😎?)
  • Delicious and affordable lunch at the office prepared by our lunch heroes.
  • Access to Urban Sports Club for Business arrangement (to promote your healthy lifestyle!)
  • Learning programs development opportunities through our L&D department.
  • Engaging workshops and inspirational talks.
  • One day off per year to do voluntary work paid by Swapfiets.
  • Flexibility to work from and at the office in Amsterdam.

Ready for the Swapfiets adventure?
If you’re excited about contributing to a sustainable and rapidly growing company, we encourage you to apply!

title: Automotive Assistant Manager
description:
Company Overview

Founded in 1978 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado, the Grease Monkey® brand currently operates more than 300 centers internationally with operations in Mexico, China, Colombia and Saudi Arabia. Grease Monkey® is the nation’s largest independent franchisor of automotive oil change centers and is looking to expand in 2021 by opening 30+ new locations. Grease Monkey® International, LLC is the nation’s largest independent franchisor of automotive oil change centers serving more than 2 million customers each year.

Our Grease Monkey® Certified Pit Crews offer customers a service experience that is unrivaled in the automotive industry. Our highly trained technicians are certified using our proprietary Grease Monkey® Technician Training & Certification Program. Grease Monkey® certified pit crews offer drivers an exceptional experience, delivered with speed and precision.

Position Overview

The Assistant Manager is responsible for performing all Center Manager function in the Manager’s absence and generally acting as “second-in-command” at the center. The Assistant Manager is responsible for the successful operation of a Grease Monkey center using customer and employee relations skills, business management techniques, and sound judgment.

Responsibilities

Customer Relations

Welcome customers immediately in a professional manner. requirements, Grease Monkey services and pricing during the Welcome, Wait/Show and Departure.

  • Present air filter, cabin air filter, breather, and radiator cap if applicable, for customer inspection.
  • Maintain communications with waiting customers, keep them informed of wait times, and answer questions. Ensure a comfortable, clean, and safe atmosphere for customers.
  • Review Service Order Ticket, including the Warranty and Free Top-Off Programs on the back, thoroughly with customers at check-out, explain services performed, purpose of static sticker and reminder card.
  • Remind departing customers to submit feedback about their visit.
  • Thank all departing customers and remind them to return.
  • Resolve customer complaints and damage claims.

Employee Supervision and Management

The center manager is responsible for the direct supervision of all employees of the center. Duties include:

  • Hire new employees as needed; Evaluate employee performance on a regular basis; Resolve employee complaints; Administer employee discipline as required; Discharge employees as required
  • Provide thorough training to new employees, conduct routine training sessions for all employees (new products, services, skills, procedures, policies)
  • Schedule employees for effective center coverage and efficient use of labor; Ensure accurate time-clock use
  • Prepare payroll each pay period
  • Maintain accurate and complete employee files

Center Operations

  • Ensure proper execution of all activities in the service bays
  • Print and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales and inventory reports
  • Monitor cash register functions and credit card handling
  • Maintain POS computer software and hardware (backups, upgrades, routine maintenance) Make daily bank deposit(s)
  • Perform daily close-out procedure
  • Prepare weekly and monthly paperwork
  • Monitor inventory, place appropriate orders, and perform accurate monthly inventory counts
  • Ensure cleanliness and appeal of entire site
  • Maintain safe working environment
  • Maintain physical plant, tools, equipment, inventory, supplies, and personal property

Other Duties and Responsibilities

  • Write and mail customer thank you notes
  • Solicit fleet accounts
  • Plan and execute local center marketing functions
  • Participate in community activities
  • Maintain required postings and records (OSHA, MSDS, federal, state, and local)

Qualifications

  • Skills: Business Management, Employee Relations, Customer Service, Intermediate Computing skills
  • Basic literacy (ready, writing, math skills); Verbal communication skills
  • Ability and licensed to operate motor vehicles; Ability to properly use mechanical hand tools
  • Previous experience managing a retail automotive center or equivalent related business required

Working Conditions

Environment: Frequent exposure to outside weather elements, noise, and vehicle exhaust fumes throughout the entire shift.

Physical Activities: Position requires good corrected vision, hearing, frequent standing, walking, climbing, stooping, crouching, handling, reaching, and lifting.

Benefits/Perks

  • Discounted Services for Employees
  • Flexible Hours
  • Opportunities for Advancement

title: Speech-Language Pathology Assistant (SLPA)
description:
Full-Time | South Asheville Clinic | Asheville, NC
45,000–52,000/year + $2,500 Sign-On Bonus
Monday–Friday · No nights or weekends


Help Kids Find Their Words, With a Team That Has Your Back.

At Carolina Pediatric Therapy (CPT), we believe every child deserves the opportunity to communicate, connect, and grow—and the right team can make all the difference.

Are you passionate about helping children find their voice? Do you love celebrating the little victories that lead to big changes? Are you looking for a full-time opportunity where you can build your clinical skills, develop meaningful relationships, and make a lasting impact?

We’re looking for a Speech-Language Pathology Assistant (SLPA) to join our South Asheville clinic team!

You’ll work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized treatment plans developed by a licensed Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP). You won’t be expected to create treatment plans from scratch or navigate your work alone. Instead, you’ll have guidance from experienced clinicians, opportunities to collaborate with an interdisciplinary team, and dedicated time to complete your documentation.

Bring your energy. Grow your skills. Make a difference.

Big Progress Starts With Small Moments.

Imagine helping a child practice new words while playing a favorite game. Celebrating when a preschooler uses language to share an idea. Supporting a child as they learn to communicate their wants and needs more independently. Watching a family light up when a skill from therapy begins showing up at home.

These are the moments that make pediatric speech-language therapy so rewarding.

At CPT, you’ll help children build communication skills, confidence, and independence while supporting families as they carry those skills into everyday life. Your work matters, and you’ll be part of a team that recognizes the difference you make.


Pay That Grows With You

We want you to understand your earning potential and have a clear path for professional growth.

  • Starting salary of 45,000–52,000, based on experience.
  • A clear pathway to $56,000 through four pay levels with defined opportunities for advancement.
  • $2,500 sign-on bonus with a one-year commitment.
  • Part-time and per-visit opportunities may also be available. Ask us about options that fit your schedule.

Why SLPAs Choose Carolina Pediatric Therapy

Paid documentation time and helpful technology
Enjoy two hours of dedicated documentation time built into each full-time workday, along with access to an AI scribe to help draft your notes.

Consistent supervision and mentorship
Receive weekly check-ins with your supervising SLP, ongoing clinical guidance, and opportunities to ask questions, discuss progress, and build confidence in your work.

A full team down the hall
Collaborate with SLPs, occupational therapists, physical therapists, psychology professionals, and behavioral health clinicians who share a commitment to whole-child care.

A manageable path to building your caseload
Families in our community need speech therapy, and we’ll help you build your caseload step by step while developing your clinical skills and confidence.

Opportunities to learn and grow
Participate in Learning Collaboratives, access continuing education resources, and explore areas of clinical interest. Tuition support may also be available for team members pursuing graduate school.

A supportive, team-centered culture
Work alongside clinicians who share ideas, celebrate progress, and value collaboration, curiosity, and professional development.


Benefits That Support You

We believe caring for children starts with supporting the people who care for them.

  • Medical insurance, with dental and vision options available.
  • Three weeks of paid time off in your first year.
  • Up to 10 paid holidays.
  • 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Life insurance.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and mental health support.
  • Professional development opportunities and continuing education support.

What You’ll Do

As a clinic-based SLPA, you’ll work under the supervision of a licensed Speech-Language Pathologist to support the delivery of individualized pediatric speech-language services.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Implementing treatment activities and strategies established by your supervising SLP.
  • Providing speech-language therapy services within your authorized scope of practice and supervision requirements.
  • Engaging children in play-based, developmentally appropriate activities that support their communication goals.
  • Collecting and documenting data related to treatment goals and client performance.
  • Communicating observations, questions, and progress with your supervising SLP.
  • Supporting family education and home practice activities as directed by your supervising SLP.
  • Maintaining accurate, timely documentation and following clinic procedures.
  • Collaborating with your clinical team to create a positive, supportive experience for children and families.

You’ll Fit Right In If You…

  • Love working with children and are passionate about communication development.
  • Bring warmth, patience, creativity, and enthusiasm to therapy sessions.
  • Value child-led, family-centered care.
  • Are dependable, organized, and receptive to feedback.
  • Enjoy learning from experienced clinicians and collaborating with a team.
  • Feel comfortable engaging children through play-based and functional activities.
  • Want to grow professionally while contributing to a mission-driven pediatric therapy team.

title: Senior Front-end Developer
description:
Amsterdam - As a Senior Front-end Developer, you help bring quality journalism to millions of readers every day. You join one of the teams within our News Area and build the web platform behind our premium news and magazine brands using Next.js and TypeScript. You collaborate with experienced colleagues in a cross-functional environment where quality, ownership and continuous improvement are central. Read on to find out more!

What will you be doing?
As a Senior Front-end Developer, you build front-end solutions that enable our newsrooms to tell their stories more effectively while providing readers with a fast, accessible and reliable experience. Your technical expertise strengthens both your team and the wider engineering community, ensuring our platform remains robust, scalable and future-ready. Without your contribution, opportunities to improve platform quality, performance and developer experience would be missed. You achieve this by:

  • Designing, developing, testing, deploying and operating front-end features from idea to production following the "You build it, you run it" principle.

  • Preparing technical proposals together with the architect and making well-founded technical decisions for the modules your team develops.

  • Identifying bottlenecks, improving platform performance, scalability and reliability, and advocating for refactoring where needed.

  • Raising engineering quality by writing maintainable code, extending automated testing and helping the team determine where test automation delivers the most value.

  • Introducing new technologies and engineering practices, mentoring less experienced front-end developers, and supporting the adoption of AI-assisted development tools through pairing, mobbing and technical knowledge-sharing sessions.

About the team
Our News Area consists of 10 teams that build and operate the digital platforms for DPG Media's news brands in the Netherlands and Belgium. You will work on our white-label platform for premium brands including De Volkskrant, Trouw, Het Parool, De Morgen and HUMO.

You become part of a cross-functional feature team consisting of front-end, back-end and mobile developers, a QA engineer, a UX designer and a Product Owner. Together you deliver features that span the entire platform, from CMS integrations to the user experience readers see on screen. Beyond your own team, you collaborate closely with front-end developers across the organisation to shape the future of our web platform.

How we work
We believe in delivering meaningful impact by focusing on the work that matters most. We communicate openly, ask questions until we fully understand the challenge and provide honest, constructive feedback. Teams work autonomously within shared goals while actively sharing knowledge and expertise across the organisation.

Ownership extends from the initial idea through to production and ongoing operation. We stay involved until solutions deliver value for both readers and colleagues. Curiosity drives continuous improvement as we experiment, learn from outcomes and embrace opportunities to innovate.

What makes you the ideal candidate?
For this role, we are looking for an experienced front-end developer with a collaborative mindset. You work independently, understand the broader context behind technical challenges and enjoy helping both colleagues and the platform grow. In addition, you have:

  • Extensive experience with React, Next.js and TypeScript in large-scale, high-traffic web environments.

  • Experience with Storybook, NX monorepos, Jest, Playwright and Node.js.

  • Strong knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG).

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, knowing when to rely on them and when to validate their output.

  • Experience with AWS or a headless CMS is considered an advantage.

What do we offer?
At DPG Media, you will work in an inspiring environment that is constantly evolving. You will join colleagues who think in possibilities, see opportunities and support your professional development every day. Through our DPG Academy, you will have every opportunity to continue growing and develop yourself as a media professional.

  • 💰 A salary between €5.000 and €7.000 gross per month

  • 📝 A 36-hour working week.

  • 💰 8% holiday allowance and a 4% personal choice budget.

  • 💰 Annual profit sharing based on DPG Media's performance.

  • 🎓 Plenty of opportunities for personal and professional development through your role and via our DPG Academy / DPG Campus.

  • 🎉 The possibility to choose your own cultural holidays.

  • 🏢 A modern office in Amsterdam (Mediavaert). From spontaneous social gatherings to team events and our legendary staff party, you'll quickly feel at home.

Even more reasons to join DPG Media
At DPG Media, we work for more than 90 leading news brands, magazines, television programmes, radio stations and online services such as Qmusic, , Tweakers, Libelle, VTM and many more. Every month, we reach more than 90% of people in the Netherlands and 8 out of 10 people in Belgium.

We offer a professional working environment where freedom and responsibility go hand in hand. You will have every opportunity to invest in your future through workshops and training. Feel free to be an entrepreneur, a learner, a team player and, above all, yourself. Everyone is welcome at DPG Media, regardless of background. More than 5,500 colleagues are ready to welcome you, whether that's into a project team, a pub quiz team or a sports team.

Discover what we have to offer. And while you're at it, you can also find us on Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

Apply, what's next?
Ready to get started? Apply now! You will receive a response to your application within 10 working days informing you whether you have been selected for the first interview round. If selected, we will contact you by phone to schedule an interview at our office in Amsterdam. The process entails 2 interviews and an assessment could be part of the 2nd interview.

title: Administratief HR-Assistent
description:
Jij houdt de administratie op orde en weet wat er speelt bij onze specialisten. Je beantwoordt vragen, zoekt uit wat er nodig is en neemt zelf contact op als iets aandacht vraagt. Je vindt het prettig als gegevens kloppen, maar haalt minstens zoveel plezier uit het contact met mensen.

Bij STAR verbinden we technische specialisten aan projecten in onder meer energie, industrie en infrastructuur. Als Administratief HR-Assistent zorg jij dat achter de schermen alles goed geregeld is én dat onze specialisten zich persoonlijk geholpen voelen.

Dit is waar jij je voor inzet

Je bent een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor onze specialisten en interne collega’s. Van een vraag over een declaratie tot ontbrekende personeelsdocumenten: jij helpt mensen verder en zorgt dat afspraken worden opgevolgd. Je vraagt door, denkt mee en pakt de telefoon als dat sneller of prettiger werkt.

Binnenkort gaat het team met een nieuw systeem werken. Daardoor worden meer administratieve handelingen geautomatiseerd en verschuift jouw werk naar controleren, afwijkingen signaleren en opvolgen. Jij kijkt kritisch of gegevens kloppen en of processen goed verlopen. Zie je dat iets handiger kan? Dan bespreek je dat en denk je mee over een oplossing.

Die verandering geeft ook ruimte om het contact met onze specialisten verder te verbeteren. Door bereikbaar te zijn, te weten wat er speelt en zelf contact te zoeken. Je wacht dus niet alleen op vragen, maar kijkt ook vooruit: wat heeft iemand nodig en wat kunnen we beter regelen?

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Beantwoorden en opvolgen van administratieve vragen van specialisten en collega’s

  • Controleren en bijhouden van personeelsdocumentatie, zoals VOG’s en declaraties

  • Ondersteunen van de backoffice bij controles op urenregistraties en het verwerken van projectgegevens

  • Signaleren van ontbrekende gegevens of afwijkingen en zorgen dat deze worden opgelost

  • Delen van relevante informatie en rapportages tijdens teamoverleggen

  • Oppakken van praktische en organisatorische zaken op jouw locatie

What’s in it for me?

Je komt terecht in een gezellig en betrokken team. We helpen elkaar, delen onze kennis en vinden het belangrijk dat je je op je plek voelt. Je krijgt begeleiding van ervaren collega’s en het vertrouwen om zelfstandig te werken. Jouw ideeën zijn welkom: samen kijken we hoe we het werk slimmer kunnen organiseren en onze specialisten nog beter kunnen helpen.

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een goed salaris tussen de €2800 en €3250 o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband en een goede pensioenregeling.

  • Collectieve verzekeringen en een bedrijfsfitnessregeling.

  • Een laptop en iPhone van de zaak.

  • Trainingen en persoonlijke coaching om je verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Eigen verantwoordelijkheid, met collega’s om op terug te vallen.

  • Bedrijfsuitjes, goede borrels en office workouts.

Wat breng je mee?

Je werkt nauwkeurig en maakt makkelijk contact. Je vindt het belangrijk dat mensen goed geholpen worden en vraagt door om te begrijpen wat iemand nodig heeft. Ontbreekt er informatie of blijft een vraag liggen? Dan ga jij erachteraan. Je houdt overzicht, stelt prioriteiten en denkt mee als je ziet dat iets beter kan. Daarnaast:

  • Heb je een afgeronde mbo 4- of hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in administratie, office of hospitality

  • Werk je makkelijk met digitale systemen en maak je je nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen

  • Ben je flexibel. Als Administratief HR-Assistent loopt je dag soms anders verwacht, waardoor flexibiliteit belangrijk is

  • Je spreekt goed Nederlands, maar kan je ook in het Engels verstaanbaar maken

Kennismaken?

We horen graag van je! Solliciteer via de onderstaande button. Eerst iets vragen over de functie of het team? Bel of app Evi Wilshaus op +31 6 57 67 18 48.

title: Sport Department Manager (Decathlon KL 118)
location: Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description:
Join the Founding Team: Decathlon KL 118!

Are you ready to elevate your passion for sport to new heights at Malaysia’s most iconic landmark? Do you have the leadership grit to drive a business in the heart of Kuala Lumpur’s newest architectural marvel? Then join us as a Founding Sport Department Manager at our flagship Decathlon KL 118 store!

This isn't just a career move; it’s a historic opportunity to be part of the pioneering leadership team at Merdeka 118. We are looking for high-energy, entrepreneurial leaders who want to live an "Experience of a Lifetime" and establish Decathlon as the premier sports destination for the vibrant, international community in the heart of KL.

Why Join the Decathlon KL 118 Team?

  • Lead a Landmark: Experience the prestige of a flagship store opening at the second-tallest building in the world. You’ll be instrumental in shaping the culture and premium service standards of our most ambitious location yet.

  • The Pulse of the City: Work in a high-octane, global hub. You’ll cater to a diverse mix of urban athletes, corporate professionals, and tourists, developing expertise in high-demand urban segments like Running, Mobility, Fitness, and Outdoor Sports.

  • Accelerated Growth: At Decathlon, we don’t just offer jobs; we build CEOs. As a manager in a high-profile flagship, you will have front-row access to elite leadership training and a fast-track path to regional or international roles within our global network.

  • Impact the Community: Be the face of Decathlon in KL’s new epicenter. You’ll build a local community of sport enthusiasts, fostering partnerships and gearing up a new generation of athletes.

About This Role

1. Be the Business Leader & Strategist

  • Focus: Drive economic performance and long-term strategy.

  • Action: Act as the CEO of your sport. You will analyze the KL market, set commercial policies, forecast sales, manage budgets, and make autonomous decisions on product range and store layout to smash annual targets.

2. Coach & Develop Your Champions

  • Focus: Recruit, train, and inspire a high-performing team.

  • Action: You’ll scout and hire "sporty" talent, providing daily on-the-floor coaching. You are responsible for creating individual development plans, ensuring your team has the skills and confidence to lead their own aisles.

3. Deliver an Iconic Customer Experience

  • Focus: Ensure every visitor receives world-class advice.

  • Action: Beyond product knowledge, you will manage your team’s scheduling to ensure expert coverage is always available, building a loyal customer base through authentic, sport-led interactions.

4. Master Layout & Inventory Excellence

  • Focus: Maintain a premium, high-availability department.

  • Action: Curate an attractive and intuitive layout that reflects our flagship status. You’ll use automated systems to guarantee 100% stock accuracy, ensuring our users always find what they need.

5. Ensure Safety & Operational Integrity

  • Focus: Protect people, goods, and the Decathlon brand.

  • Action: Enforce rigorous safety standards and security procedures to combat shrinkage. As a leader, you will also step up to Lead the entire store as Duty Manager, overseeing operations for the whole site when scheduled.

Profile

We are looking for game-changers and sports enthusiasts ready to lead a commercial department and rapidly progress to a Store Leader role!

1. Education & Experience

  • Minimum Qualification: At least Diploma required (any field).

  • Experience: Opened to final-year students, fresh graduates, and more experienced candidates.

2. Passion & Mindset

  • Passion for Sports: A deep, genuine love for sports is essential to connect with our customers.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: A go-getter who is vital, responsible, and driven to own their department's commercial success.

  • Continuous Improvement: A strong desire to learn and an eagerness to thrive in a vibrant and agile environment.

3. Communication & Interpersonal Skills

  • Language: Strong communication skills in both English and Bahasa Malaysia (written and spoken) are essential. Other languages are a plus.

  • Team Player: High level of integrity and the ability to engage, listen, and influence customers and teammates effectively.

  • Digital Savvy: Comfortable leveraging digital tools and technology in a retail environment.

4. Commitment & Flexibility

  • Work Schedule: Must be able to play as part of the team during the busiest times (i.e., flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays).

title: Automotive Center Manager
description:
Benefits:
  • Company parties
  • Competitive salary
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee discounts
  • Free food & snacks
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Training & development
Company Overview
Founded in 1978 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado, the Grease Monkey® brand currently operates more than 300 centers internationally with operations in Mexico, China, Colombia and Saudi Arabia. Grease Monkey® is the nation’s largest independent franchisor of automotive oil change centers and is looking to expand in 2021 by opening 30+ new locations. Grease Monkey® International, LLC is the nation’s largest independent franchisor of automotive oil change centers serving more than 2 million customers each year.
Our Grease Monkey® Certified Pit Crews offer customers a service experience that is unrivaled in the automotive industry. Our highly trained technicians are certified using our proprietary Grease Monkey® Technician Training & Certification Program. Grease Monkey® certified pit crews offer drivers an exceptional experience, delivered with speed and precision.
Position Overview
The Center Manager is responsible for the successful operation and profitability of a Grease Monkey center using customer and employee relations skills, business management techniques, and sound judgment.
Responsibilities:
  • Customer Relations
Welcome customers immediately in a professional manner. requirements, Grease Monkey services and pricing during the Welcome, Wait/Show and Departure.
  • Present air filter, cabin air filter, breather, and radiator cap if applicable, for customer inspection.
  • Maintain communications with waiting customers, keep them informed of wait times, and answer questions. Ensure a comfortable, clean, and safe atmosphere for customers.
  • Review Service Order Ticket, including the Warranty and Free Top-Off Programs on the back, thoroughly with customers at check-out, explain services performed, purpose of static sticker and reminder card.
  • Remind departing customers to submit feedback about their visit.
  • Thank all departing customers and remind them to return.
  • Resolve customer complaints and damage claims.
Employee Supervision and Management
The Center Manager is responsible for the direct supervision of all employees of the center. Duties include:
  • Hire new employees as needed; Evaluate employee performance on a regular basis; Resolve employee complaints; Administer employee discipline as required; Discharge employees as required
  • Provide thorough training to new employees, conduct routine training sessions for all employees (new products, services, skills, procedures, policies)
  • Schedule employees for effective center coverage and efficient use of labor and ensure accurate time-clock use
  • Prepare payroll each pay period
  • Maintain accurate and complete employee files
Center Operations
  • Ensure proper execution of all activities in the service bays
  • Print and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales and inventory reports
  • Monitor cash register functions and credit card handling
  • Maintain POS computer software and hardware (backups, upgrades, routine maintenance) Make daily bank deposit(s)
  • Perform daily close-out procedure
  • Prepare weekly and monthly paperwork
  • Monitor inventory, place appropriate orders, and perform accurate monthly inventory counts
  • Ensure cleanliness and appeal of entire site
  • Maintain safe working environment
  • Maintain physical plant, tools, equipment, inventory, supplies, and personal property
Other Duties and Responsibilities
  • Write and mail customer thank you notes
  • Solicit fleet accounts
  • Plan and execute local center marketing functions
  • Participate in community activities
  • Maintain required postings and records (OSHA, MSDS, federal, state, and local)
Qualifications
  • Skills: Business Management, Employee Relations, Customer Service, Intermediate Computing skills
  • Basic literacy (ready, writing, math skills); Verbal communication skills
  • Ability and licensed to operate motor vehicles; Ability to properly use mechanical hand tools
  • Previous experience managing a retail automotive center or equivalent related business required
Working Conditions
Environment: Frequent exposure to outside weather elements, noise, and vehicle exhaust fumes throughout the entire shift.
Physical Activities: Position requires good corrected vision, hearing, frequent standing, walking, climbing, stooping, crouching, handling, reaching, and lifting.
Benefits/Perks
  • Discounted Services for Employees
  • Flexible Hours
  • Opportunities for Advancement

title: Sr. React Developer
description:
Altimetrik is a leading digital business enablement company. Our agile professionals and engineering teams craft innovative solutions that drive transformation and growth for businesses worldwide.

We are looking for a Sr. React.Js Developer with strong expertise in React and TypeScript to build scalable, intuitive, and reliable digital experiences. This role requires a combination of technical excellence, product thinking, UX judgment, and end-to-end ownership.

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of professional experience building production-grade frontend applications.
  • Advanced expertise in React and TypeScript.

  • Solid knowledge of automated testing and frontend quality practices.

  • Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs using OpenAPI-generated types and data-fetching hooks.
