title: Senior Associate, US&C Commercial, Performance Enablement
description:
About the role and team

Uber’s Commercial Sales Enablement team supports our multi-billion dollar Delivery business, including Uber Eats, Grocery & Retail, and Direct. We equip our sales teams with the capabilities, tools, insights, and processes needed to increase seller and account manager productivity, accelerate growth, and improve merchant outcomes.

As the Senior Associate, US&C Commercial Enablement Performance Enablement, you will help fully tenured Account Executives and Account Managers strengthen their skills and improve performance on the commercial motions and activities that matter most. Working alongside reps in a designated Uber office, you will provide individual and small-group coaching, facilitate targeted training, and reinforce effective practices in their day-to-day work.

You will partner with frontline managers and commercial leaders to understand business priorities, competitive trends, and team performance needs. Using commercial performance data, insights from tools such as Agentforce, and direct observation, you will identify coaching opportunities and deliver practical support that helps reps translate learning into stronger execution and measurable results.

This role requires a strong coach and facilitator who understands sales and account management, builds trust with experienced reps, and uses evidence to focus support where it can have the greatest impact.

What you’ll do

  • Identify performance and skill gaps: Use commercial performance data, manager input, rep feedback, call reviews, and insights from tools such as Agentforce to identify specific behaviors and activities where coaching could improve results.
  • Provide hands-on, in-office coaching: Work alongside tenured Account Executives and Account Managers through individual coaching, small-group sessions, live practice, and follow-up support as they apply new skills.
  • Strengthen core commercial motions: Coach reps on topics such as prospecting, discovery, pipeline management, solution selling, objection handling, negotiation, account planning, merchant engagement, retention, and account growth, tailored to their roles and needs.
  • Translate strategy into practical execution: Partner with commercial leaders and frontline managers to understand regional priorities, competitive trends, and changes in merchant needs. Turn these insights into relevant coaching, practice activities, and guidance for reps.
  • Partner with frontline managers: Align on coaching priorities, define observable behaviors and success measures, and share progress and recommendations. Equip managers to reinforce learning through their ongoing coaching and performance conversations.
  • Deliver targeted performance programs: Coordinate focused coaching and training interventions for specific teams, skills, or commercial opportunities, adapting existing enablement resources to local needs.
  • Measure progress and refine support: Track changes in skill proficiency, rep behaviors, and relevant performance indicators. Use results and feedback to adjust coaching and share effective practices with the broader Enablement team.
  • Reinforce effective use of sales technology: Help reps use Salesforce, Seismic, Agentforce, conversational intelligence, and other approved tools to improve preparation, execution, and productivity.
  • Surface broader opportunities: Share recurring skill gaps, competitive insights, and workflow challenges with Enablement and commercial partners, helping distinguish coaching needs from issues that require process, product, or operational changes.

Basic qualifications

  • A minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Sales Enablement, sales, account management, Learning & Development, Commercial Operations, or a related field.
  • Experience coaching customer-facing professionals or facilitating skill development through training, workshops, role plays, call reviews, or structured feedback.
  • Experience supporting or working in sales or account management, with an understanding of core commercial motions, activities, and performance expectations.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret performance data and combine it with qualitative insights to identify gaps and recommend practical actions.
  • Experience partnering with frontline managers or business stakeholders to understand priorities, coordinate support, and track progress.
  • Experience using CRM, reporting, sales productivity, or enablement tools to support daily work and evaluate outcomes.
  • Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple coaching priorities and maintain clear records of activities and progress.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to explain concepts clearly, provide actionable feedback, and communicate effectively with reps, managers, and commercial leaders.
  • Ability to work from the designated US&C Uber office/hub according to Uber’s applicable work schedule, with in-person presence aligned to rep coaching and team needs.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience coaching tenured Account Executives or Account Managers to improve specific skills, behaviors, and commercial outcomes.
  • Experience in B2B sales or account management, particularly within a marketplace, technology, advertising, delivery, or merchant-facing business.
  • Demonstrated success delivering targeted coaching or training that contributed to improvements in conversion, pipeline quality, sales cycle progression, retention, account growth, or other relevant measures.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Agentforce, Seismic, Tableau, conversational intelligence, or comparable sales and enablement platforms.
  • Experience using AI-powered insights to identify coaching opportunities, personalize support, or improve rep productivity, while validating recommendations against performance data and manager context.
  • Experience translating competitive trends, customer insights, and commercial priorities into practical selling guidance and skill development.
  • Ability to build credibility with experienced reps and adapt coaching to different roles, skill levels, and business needs.

title: Data Scientist, Full Stack
description:
Job Type: Full-Time l Location: San Francisco, CA l Department: AI Infrastructure Supply Chain l Reporting to: Director, Supply Chain Analytics & Engineering | Work Location Type: #hybrid

IREN is a leading AI Cloud Service Provider, delivering large-scale GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s vertically integrated platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and data centers in renewable-rich regions across the U.S. and Canada.

The Data Scientist, Full Stack supports the modernization of IREN’s global Supply Chain systems and tools portfolio. Reporting to the Director, Supply Chain Analytics & Engineering, this individual-contributor role builds and operates the pipelines, data models, and dashboards that underpin the teams analytics, and contributes to the data architecture, tooling standards, and ways of working as they are established. The work spans GPU and compute hardware, networking, power and electrical equipment, construction materials and services – categories with long lead times, constrained supply and high capital intensity, where data quality directly affects delivery dates and cost.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way - responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
Job requirements

Responsibilities

Data pipelines and integration
  • Design, build and maintain reliable ELT/ETL pipelines from supply chain source systems (ERP, procurement/P2P, inventory and warehouse, project controls, logistics and supplier portals) into the analytics platform.
  • Integrate external data such as supplier catalogs, lead-time and market-price feeds, freight and customs data, and OEM shipment notifications.
  • Operate and improve pipeline orchestration, scheduling, monitoring and alerting so data lands on time and failures are caught before users see them.
Data modeling and standards
  • Build and document the supply chain data model: supplier, material/part, purchase order, contract, receipt, inventory, shipment and project/site dimensions and facts.
  • Help define conformed dimensions and master-data rules (supplier hierarchy, category taxonomy, site and project codes) under the guidance of the Director, Supply Chain Analytics & Engineering and master-data owners.
  • Follow and help refine the team’s engineering standards: version control, code review, testing, environments and deployment.
Data quality and governance
  • Implement automated data-quality checks (completeness, freshness, reconciliation to source) and publish data-quality metrics.
  • Maintain data lineage, definitions and a catalog so analysts and business users can trust and find the data.
  • Implement the defined security model and privacy safeguards, address data quality issues, and contribute to governance processes within allocated areas of ownership.
Analytics enablement
  • Partner with analysts to deliver the datasets behind spend cubes, supplier scorecards, lead-time and on-time-delivery tracking, inventory health and transformation KPIs.
  • Design, build, and launch dashboards and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different domains.
  • Contribute to the data foundations for forecasting and planning use cases (demand and lead-time forecasting, should-cost, supplier risk) and support analytics and data science teammates in productionizing models.
  • Support system-selection and implementation work (procurement, planning and supplier-management tools) by defining data requirements and integration patterns.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years in data engineering or data science, with at least 1 year building pipelines and data models for supply chain, procurement, operations or finance data.
  • Strong data-driven storytelling skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to technical and business audiences.
  • Working understanding of supply chain processes and stakeholder interactions, and experience working with ERP/MRP, CLM, PLM, QMS tools.
  • Strong SQL and Python; familiarity with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework.
  • Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data platform (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery or Redshift) and an orchestration tool (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar).
  • Exposure to AI-native analytics tools and workflows.
  • Experience working with data from ERP and procurement systems (for example SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Dynamics, Coupa or Ariba) via APIs, extracts or CDC.
  • Working knowledge of dimensional modeling, master-data concepts and data-quality practices.
  • Software engineering fundamentals: Git, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD basics.
  • Preferred: experience in data center, AI infrastructure, energy, construction or other capital-project-heavy industries with long-lead equipment (GPUs, networking, transformers, switchgear, generators).
  • Strong hands-on problem solving, data analysis, and communication skills, with the ability to operate autonomously across analytics, engineering, and supply chain teams.
Other important requirements
  • Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing, may be required according to company policies.
  • Must be able to reliably commute to the assigned office location on scheduled in-office days under the hybrid work arrangement.
  • This role requires willingness to travel domestically and internationally to supplier and vendor sites, data centers, implementation partner locations, and industry events.
  • IREN does not yet have an office in the Bay Area (a Santa Clara office is planned); until it opens, this role will work remotely, transitioning to hybrid on-site work once the office is established.

The IREN Package
At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.

title: Systems Engineer – Radio Communications & Antenna Technology (m/f/d)
description:
Design, integrate and validate radio and IP network solutions for state-of-the-art air defence systems – from system architecture and test planning through to first deployment in the field.

Your Role & Responsibilities

  • Develop, integrate and optimise systems and components with radio communication, including their integration into tactical IP networks

  • Create concepts, architectures (HLD/LLD), specifications and test plans for systems and components, with a focus on VHF/UHF data links

  • Act as subject matter expert for radio and network configurations, covering IP switching and routing, virtualisation and secure communications

  • Analyse, model and simulate radio and antenna systems, and develop antenna concepts for platforms such as vehicles, shelters or containers

  • Plan and perform system tests, performance analyses and validations in the lab and in the field (e.g. EMC, antenna characteristics, RF performance, interference)

  • Develop test tools, define KPIs and prepare factory and site acceptance tests (FAT/SAT)

  • Perform advanced troubleshooting of complex communication systems

  • Engage with customers, suppliers and external partners to define new technical features and evaluate equipment

  • Carry out requirements engineering with full traceability (e.g. IBM DOORS NG)

  • Support on-site first deployments, commissioning and troubleshooting

  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams across the customer, suppliers and internal departments

  • Create and maintain technical documentation (specifications, test reports, operation manuals)

Required Technical & Professional Expertise

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Communications Engineering, Computer Science or a comparable field

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in radio communications, RF/antenna technology and/or network engineering, ideally in defence, rail or other mission-critical environments

  • Solid knowledge of RF design, antenna theory and radio protocols (e.g. VHF/UHF, Wi-Fi, 4G/5G)

  • Strong IP networking skills: routing and switching (e.g. OSPF, BGP, MPLS), VLANs, QoS and network virtualisation

  • Good understanding of cybersecurity in communication networks (firewalls, RADIUS/NAC, secure network architectures)

  • Experience with simulation tools such as CST, HFSS, MATLAB or comparable environments

  • Confident handling of RF measurement equipment (VNA, spectrum analyser, field strength measurement) and network analysis tools (e.g. Wireshark, iPerf)

  • Experience with military signals or tactical communication systems is a strong advantage

  • Analytical, structured way of working, strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on attitude in the lab and in the field

  • Team player with strong communication skills and willingness to travel to test and deployment sites

  • Very good English skills (written and spoken); German is a strong advantage

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU citizenship required) and willingness to undergo a Swiss personnel security screening

Sitting at the intersection of business operations and technology, you will design, integrate, and optimize cutting-edge enterprise applications leveraging clean-core SAP methodologies and low-code/AI automation tools. Main Responsibilities



  • Solution Design & Business Integration: Apply conceptual knowledge of business processes to design, prototype, and implement innovative SAP and non-SAP technical solutions (using ABAP, CDS views, RESTful ABAP Programming Model, OData, Cloud Application Programming (CAP), Fiori/UI5, and low-code tools like Retool) that directly optimize supply chain operations.

  • Systems & Automation Knowledge: Practical experience with shop-floor integrations (e.g., AVEVA/MES or SAP MII) and familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Retool) or modern AI/automation development tools.

title: Transport Planner
location: Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
description:
About the Role

Are you organized, adaptable logistics professional who thrives in dynamic supply chain environments? We are looking for a Transport Planner to take ownership of our daily end-to-end transport operations. In this role, you will bridge Post-Carriage Upstream and Last-Mile transport, optimizing routing, coordinating custom clearances and managing carrier relationships. Your primary focus will be ensuring our shipments are delivered efficiently, on time, securely and sustainably while keeping overcosts to a minimum.

Key Responsibilities

1. Daily Transport Execution & Operational Monitoring
  • Shipment Tracking & Delay Management: Proactively track transport dates (ETA/ETD, shipping and delivery promises) across all modes to resolve potential delays before they impact customers.
  • Warehouse & Arrival Scheduling: Align transport schedules with warehouse reception management to optimize unloading capacity.
  • Resource & Equipment Coordination: Coordinate specialized equipment requests, including barge scheduling and chassis recovery, to meet fluctuating volume needs.
  • Operational Agility: Manage urgent transport rescheduling and cancellations prior to cut-off times to avoid financial penalties and ensure uninterrupted supply.
2. Performance Optimization & Financial Efficiency
  • Carrier Selection & Load Maximization: Make strategic daily carrier choices to maximize vehicle filling rates and minimize operational overcosts.
  • Cost & Waster Reduction: Analyze daily containers fees, detention/waiting hours and operational risk points to identify and remove chain waste.

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
About Role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Leapfrog Technology, you will be at the forefront of shaping the future of data-driven solutions. You'll contribute significantly to the development of innovative ML projects, lead and mentor a talented team, and work collaboratively across functions to turn complex business challenges into actionable insights.

  • Technical Leadership: Actively contribute to the design, development, and implementation of ML projects while working collaboratively with a team of ML Engineers and Data Scientists, ensuring technical excellence and innovation.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Take full ownership of the ML project lifecycle, from ideation and design to development, deployment, and maintenance.

  • Technological Innovation: Explore and assess emerging technologies to enhance the performance, maintainability, and reliability of ML systems.

  • Engineering Best Practices: Apply robust software engineering practices to ML, including CI/CD pipelines, automation, and quality assurance.

  • Architectural Leadership: Collaborate with technology experts to make informed architectural decisions, and ensure thorough technical documentation.

  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and address project risks, conduct root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Engage closely with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, product managers, software engineers, and data engineers, to deliver impactful data-driven solutions.

  • Continuous Learning: Stay at the cutting edge of data science, ML, and AI developments, and leverage emerging technologies to solve complex business problems.

  • Mentorship and Growth: Coach and motivate team members, identify training needs, and foster their professional development.

  • Organizational Excellence: Actively uphold and promote the company's culture, processes, and standards to ensure consistent excellence in our work.

  • Education and Experience:

    • A degree (Master's preferred) in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or related fields.

    • Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning or Data Science, preferably in real industry settings, with a track record of building data products that have positively impacted customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Proficiency in a wide range of Machine Learning techniques and algorithms, with the ability to apply advanced analytics methods, including Bayesian statistics, clustering, text analysis, time series analysis, and neural networks on large-scale datasets.

    • Expertise in at least one specialized area of application, such as Computer Vision or Natural Language Processing (NLP). (NLP Expertise Preferred)

    • Strong programming skills in Python, including expertise in the data ecosystem (Numpy, Scipy, Pandas, etc.) or equivalent skills in languages like R, Java, Scala, or Julia, with a focus on producing production-quality code.

    • Hands-on experience with popular ML frameworks like Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

    • Expertise with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) along with their implementation in real-life applications.

    • Experience building end-to-end ML systems (MLOps).

    • Experience in deploying code in web frameworks such as Flask, FastAPI, or Django.

    • Experience working in a cloud environment like AWS, Azure, or GCP for ML work.

    • Good grasp of SQL/NoSQL databases and scripting skills, particularly within analytics platforms and data warehouses.

    • Good grasp of software engineering concepts (SDLC, Version Control, CI/CD, Containerization, Scalability, and so on), programming concepts, and tools/platforms like Git and Docker.

    • Bonus: Experience with Big Data technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Kinesis, and cloud-based ML platforms like AWS SageMaker or GCP ML Engine.

    • Bonus: Experience with data visualization and dashboard tools like Tableau or Power BI.

  • Soft Skills:

    • Highly motivated, self-driven, entrepreneurial mindset, and capable of solving complex analytical problems under high-pressure situations.

    • Ability to work with cross-functional and cross-regional teams.

    • Ability to lead a team of Data/ML professionals and work with senior management, technological experts, and the product team.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable with client communication.

    • Good leadership skills - ability to motivate and mentor team members, ability to plan and make sound decisions, ability to negotiate tactfully with the client and team.

    • Results-oriented, customer-focused with a passion for resolving tough technical and operational challenges.

    • Possess excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

    • Good documentation skills.

    • Experienced with Agile methodologies like Scrum/Kanban

title: Solution Line Manager
description:
Automation is een innovatief engineeringbedrijf dat zich heeft gespecialiseerd in oplossingen voor ‘low voltage electrical power’ en ‘datacenter facilities’. Als kenniscentrum bieden we maatwerkoplossingen die we samen met onze klanten ontwikkelen en implementeren.

Met meer dan 80 medewerkers beschikken we over de nodige expertise en ervaring om hoogwaardige toepassingen te leveren. En we blijven groeien!

We investeren niet alleen in onze klanten, maar ook in onze medewerkers. Bij de start ontvang je een uitgebreide opleiding on-the-job. Op lange termijn zorgen we voor persoonlijke begeleiding en bieden we volop kansen om je professionele ontwikkeling voort te zetten.

Automation blijft op volle kracht verder groeien. Om dat succes door te zetten zijn we op zoek naar een Solution Line Manager om onze business unit Power Solutions te versterken.

De functie:

Je biedt als expert technische ondersteuning aan het verkoops-, productie- en naverkoopsproces.

Initieel voorzien we een compacte, maar intensieve opleiding, waarna je instaat voor:

  • Bepalen, opvolgen en laten evolueren van het toegekende productgamma en oplossingen

  • De uitwerking van complexe product design

  • Realiseren en beheren van de nodige markt/sales ondersteunende middelen, waaronder prijsberekening, (verkoops-)documentatie, referentielijsten, technische data, specificaties en lastenboeken

  • Het vergezellen van accountmanagers als product-expert en het opstellen van offertes in samenwerking met de Inside Sales

  • Het omzetten van bestellingen naar dossiers voor Engineering

  • Het bepalen en bewaken van het prijs- en margebeleid

  • Het opstellen en uitvoeren van het product marketing plan

  • Het continu bewaken van de markt waarbij je steeds op zoek gaat naar nieuwe producten en andere opportuniteiten

  • Het promotiebeleid: je bepaalt niet alleen de inhoud maar neemt ook deel aan seminaries, beurzen, trainingen, promotionele acties, …

  • Je hebt een masterdiploma op zak bij voorkeur als ingenieur elektromechanica of aanverwant en kan dit aanvullen met enkele jaren ervaring op vlak van elektrotechniek in een industriële setting

  • Je bent een expert op vlak van elecktriciteit

  • Je bent vlot in de omgang en commercieel ingesteld

  • Je bent oplossingsgericht

  • Steeds kunnen bijleren en je kennis verder ontwikkelen vind je van groot belang

  • Je werkt opdrachten tijdig af en hebt aandacht voor detail

  • Je hebt een verzorgd voorkomen

  • Je beschikt over een goede kennis van Nederlands, Frans en Engels

  • Je hebt ervaring met ERP paketten (Navison is een plus)

Wat bieden wij aan?

Je komt terecht in een bedrijf met een vlakke structuur dat in volle groei is. Dit biedt jou de kans om samen met ons mee te ontwikkelen. Je wordt omringd door ondernemende collega’s die the extra mile willen gaan. Op die manier voorzien we de beste service aan onze klanten en houden we onze kennis steeds up-to-date.

Uiteraard houden we ook rekening met een gezonde work-life balance. Tot slot bieden we jou een aantrekkelijk salaris aangevuld met extra legale voordelen waaronder een wagen en een bonus.

Ben jij onze missende schakel?

Laat het ons weten via onderstaande knop. We kijken ernaar uit om jouw CV te ontvangen!

Role Overview
We are looking for a talented and motivated Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join our development team. The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, product owners, and engineering stakeholders to deliver high-quality features from the product backlog in an Agile environment.

The role involves both manual and automated testing, with a strong focus on test automation, continuous quality improvement, and early identification of defects. The successful candidate will contribute to ensuring product reliability, functionality, and overall quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

1. Manual & Functional Testing
  • Review product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to understand expected functionality.
  • Design, develop, and execute test cases, test scenarios, and test plans.
  • Perform functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing.

2. Test Automation

title: Solution Architect
description:
Leverage deep healthcare domain expertise to design, govern, and deliver enterprise-scale clinical, billing, and claims platforms. This role owns solution architecture across Power Platform, Azure integration services, APIs, and healthcare billing systems, ensuring secure, compliant, high-performance solutions that meet both business and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Solution Architecture & Design: Architect enterprise healthcare platforms combining Power Platform (Canvas & Model-Driven), Dataverse, PowerApps Component Framework and Azure cloud services for high-performance, scalable, and secure solutions; Translate complex clinical workflows and pharmacy operations into modular, maintainable digital systems; Design full-stack integrations with REST APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and third-party payer/EHR systems; Develop and maintain structured data models and enforce schema validation in Dataverse to support clinical codes, visit types, fee schedules, and healthcare workflow processes; Ensure HIPAA compliance, PHI security, RBAC, and auditability across all layers of the solution.

  2. End-to-End Ownership: Lead full lifecycle delivery from requirements elicitation, technical architecture, and solution design to implementation, testing, deployment, and production stabilization; Own clinical encounter workflows, billing logic, and claims-ready payloads, including CPT/HCPCS mapping, modifier assignment, insurance eligibility, prior authorization, and ABN handling; Optimize real-time payment workflows for copay, out-of-pocket, and prior authorization processes within Canvas Apps and backend APIs; Serve as technical escalation point for cross-layer dependencies spanning UI, Dataverse, PCF components, Azure services, and payer integrations.

  3. AI & Copilot Innovation: Architect AI-driven clinical and operational workflows leveraging Azure AI Foundry Services, OpenAI/GenAI, and low-code AI integrations within Power Platform; Implement predictive coding, automated claims validation, modifier recommendations, and eligibility checks to reduce errors and accelerate reimbursement; Integrate AI capabilities to enhance clinical decision support, patient triage, and workflow automation in both staff and patient-facing applications; Continuously evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies to optimize operational efficiency, claim accuracy, and patient outcomes.

  4. Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead and mentor distributed engineering teams on Power Platform best practices, full-stack development, PCF component design, Azure integration, and healthcare workflow modeling across multiple time zones; Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and performance tuning sessions to enforce high-quality, modular, and scalable solutions; Guide teams on delegation-friendly Dataverse queries, lazy loading, Named Formulas, API orchestration, and claims workflow automation; Foster a culture of technical excellence, cross-domain knowledge sharing, and adherence to healthcare compliance standards.

  5. Collaboration & Alignment: Collaborate with clinicians, pharmacy staff, DME coordinators, operational leads, and administrative stakeholders to translate real-world healthcare workflows into digital solutions; Facilitate workshops and technical reviews to align business requirements with architecture, compliance standards, and technical feasibility; Ensure workflow standardization, consistent service identifiers, CPT/HCPCS mapping, and payload accuracy across modules; Integrate clinical and billing systems with enterprise reporting, payer-specific logic, and claims processing platforms.

  6. Microsoft Product Team Collaboration: Partner with Microsoft engineering, Power CAT, and FastTrack teams to validate solution architecture, adopt platform best practices, and influence roadmap decisions; Represent the organization at Microsoft conferences and community events as a subject matter expert in healthcare digital transformation on Power Platform and Azure; Provide guidance on advanced Power Platform patterns, PCF extensibility, Azure cloud design, and enterprise-grade compliance architecture; Stay current on Power Platform, Azure, AI/ML, and healthcare technology innovations to inform long-term solution strategy.

  7. Continuous Improvement: Optimize application performance, operational efficiency, and workflow automation across clinical, billing, and DME systems; Implement CI/CD pipelines, DevOps automation, versioned managed solutions, and automated testing to ensure reliability and reproducibility; Lead data validation, payload standardization, and fee schedule updates to reduce errors, improve claim accuracy, and ensure regulatory compliance; Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies (AI, ML, Azure cloud services, integration patterns) to enhance user experience, clinical throughput, and reimbursement outcomes.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or similarly technical field; Eight (8) years’ experience with systems architecture, including at least five (5) years of specific experience with Microsoft Cloud products including Power Platform and Azure; and each of the following:

(1) Must be current holder of Microsoft FastTrack Recognized Solution Architect (FTRSA) designation (Power Platform track or Dynamics 365 track).

(2) Must have completed formal HIPAA training for software development;

(3) Demonstrated expertise in each of the following: (a) Microsoft Power Platform and Azure architecture patterns, with proven experience translating complex healthcare workflows, clinical encounters, insurance eligibility, billing, and claims into scalable, auditable digital systems; (b) The full medical billing cycle, including patient registration, insurance verification, charge capture, and final payment posting.

(4) Demonstrated experience with each of the following: (a) Designing and implementing secure PHI transmission pipelines to external systems and third-party integrations, with hands-on experience structuring data flows that comply with BAA obligations, enforcing TLS/mTLS for data in transit, managing encryption key lifecycles, and ensuring end-to-end PHI integrity across system boundaries; (b) Engineering HIPAA-compliant audit logging and access control systems from the ground up, including tamper-evident audit trails, automated access reviews, field-level encryption of PHI within databases, and role-based access models that enforce minimum necessary access at both the application and data layer; (c) Identifying and remediating HIPAA security risks within software systems, conducting technical risk assessments, threat modeling data flows that touch PHI, implementing breach detection mechanisms, and ensuring applications meet the required administrative, physical, and technical safeguard standards under the Security Rule; (d) Making architectural decisions in production healthcare systems that directly satisfy HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules at an implementation level, including the full scope of technical safeguard requirements including encryption standards, access controls, audit controls, and integrity controls; (e) Architecting automated "Claim Scrubbers" within the medical billing workflow to validate data against payer-specific edits prior to submission.

(5) Demonstrated knowledge of each of the following: (a) ICD-10/11, CPT, and HCPCS coding structures and how they impact the data schema of a D365 Healthcare implementation; (b) National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Telecommunication Standard (D.0) for real-time pharmacy adjudication; (c) Managing and automating the resolution of medical billing rejections (TA1, 999, and 277CA) resulting from technical or formatting errors at the clearinghouse level; (d) Architecting medical billing workflows for denial management, specifically using 835 Remittance Advice codes to trigger automated appeals and medical necessity reviews.

(6) Up to 25% international travel to Nepal/India is required.

title: Staff Data Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
At Adsquare, our mission is driven by our core focus:

  • Passion – Solving complex challenges with great people, tech, and data.

  • Niche – Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers.

Our core values are integral to everything we do:

  • Drive: We turn ambition into action.

  • Resilience: We adapt, persevere, and grow stronger.

  • No BS: We value honesty, transparency, and clear communication.

  • Humble: We choose modesty over vanity and let results speak for themselves.

  • Moral Compass: We do the right thing with fairness, integrity, and respect.

We seek candidates who not only bring top-tier technical expertise but also embody these values in every aspect of their work.

We are looking for a Staff Data Platform Engineer to build and own the shared data platform that the Data team and the rest of Adsquare build on: ingestion, lakehouse storage, databases, the data catalog, and the agentic tooling that sits on top of it all.

This is a highly technical, hands-on Individual Contributor (IC) role at the intersection of DevOps and data engineering. You will design data systems and also own how they are deployed, run and kept healthy in production – infrastructure as code, CI/CD, containers, observability and cost. You will be the technical lead for our data platform – making the key architectural calls and setting engineering standards – and you will build the pipelines, design and ship the services. There are no people-management responsibilities.

Our platform processes TB-scale geo-spatial data, audience attributes and location time-series. We are moving towards a data mesh, where domain squads own and publish their data as products, and towards a way of working where much of our engineering is done with and by AI agents. You will shape both.

We are looking for a builder: an engineer with deep platform knowledge who still loves shipping code, and who is excited about how AI agents are changing data engineering.

Must-Have Skills:

  1. Experience: 7+ years in Data Engineering, Data Platform or Backend Engineering, including significant time at senior or staff level with platform-wide scope – and still hands-on.

  2. Lakehouse & database design: Deep experience designing and operating lakehouse and database architectures – open table formats (e.g. Iceberg), Parquet, object storage, query engines such as Athena/Trino or Redshift, plus relational databases. You understand partitioning, compaction, schema evolution and query performance.

  3. Pipelines at scale: You have built and run batch and event-driven pipelines at TB scale (e.g. Spark, Glue, Step Functions, Airflow or Dagster), including backfills, failure recovery and data quality checks.

  4. Data mesh & data catalog: Hands-on experience with data catalogs and metadata (e.g. DataHub, OpenMetadata, AWS Sagemaker Catalog, Glue Data Catalog, Unity Catalog), lineage, data contracts or data products – or a strong, demonstrable interest in data mesh backed by adjacent experience.

  5. Agentic engineering: You work with AI coding agents every day and get real leverage from them, and you have built (or are eager to build) LLM agents, MCP servers or tools on top of data systems.

  6. Software engineering & DevOps: Strong production Python (tested, typed, maintainable) and expert SQL. A DevOps mindset: you treat infrastructure as code and are hands-on with AWS, Terraform, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD and production monitoring.

  7. Technical leadership: You drive consensus across teams, explain architectural trade-offs clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and make the people around you better.

  • Build the platform, hands-on: Design, build and operate our ingestion and processing pipelines, lakehouse, query layer and databases. Make clear trade-offs between latency, correctness, cost and long-term maintainability.

  • Make data mesh real: Turn the platform into a self-serve foundation that lets squads own, publish and consume data products. Define the standards for data contracts, schema evolution, ownership and production readiness.

  • Own catalog, metadata and lineage: Make our data discoverable, documented and trusted – with lineage, quality signals and clear ownership – so that both people and AI agents can find and use the right data.

  • Build agents for Developers: Design and ship agents, MCP servers and tools that let engineers and agents explore data, validate pipelines, debug incidents and automate routine operations. Set the team's standards for agentic coding: how we use coding agents, share skills, review agent-written code and keep guardrails in place.

  • Reliability, observability and cost: Build monitoring, alerting and data quality checks that catch problems before they reach downstream products, and keep cloud costs visible and under control.

  • Lead and multiply: Drive architecture decisions across squads, raise the bar through design and code reviews, and mentor Senior, Mid and Junior engineers.

  • Geo-spatial data: Experience with spatial indexes and tools (e.g. H3, S2, PostGIS) and location time-series data.

  • Ad-tech: Experience in programmatic advertising, audience/segment data or privacy and consent requirements.

  • Semantic layer: Experience building metrics or semantic layers that serve self-service analytics and AI-driven data access.

Python, SQL, Spark, AWS (S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions), Apache Iceberg, Redshift, dbt, Terraform, Kubernetes, Datadog, GitLab CI and AI coding agents. You will help decide what comes next.

On top of a competitive package:

  • Hybrid work, and up to 3 months a year working remotely from anywhere

  • A personal learning budget of 1,200 EUR a year

  • 30 vacation days a year

  • Urban Sports Club membership, company pension scheme and relocation / home office budget

  • Regular team and company events organised by our People team

  • Latest hardware and all tools you need to thrive

90,000 - 105,000 euros (OTE)

  1. Take at home quizzes

  2. Introductory call and Values-based interview (30 min)

  3. Tech-Screening Call (30 min)

  4. Practical take-home challenge: a data science problem on realistic data, solved with your usual tools, coding agents included (48h take at home)

  5. Deep-dive technical interview with the Data team: we discuss your take-home challenge solution, further questions about statistics, ML fundamentals, AI, coding (90 min)

  6. Meet the team (30 min)

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company Description

Otto HR is a unified platform for hiring, people operations, payroll, benefits, and compliance, powered by Otto, an AI assistant that works alongside HR teams. The company was founded to solve the challenges of managing a growing organization, replacing fragmented tools and manual workflows with a single, integrated system. Otto HR supports the entire employee lifecycle, from job posting and AI-driven candidate search to onboarding, time tracking, payroll, and benefits management, all in one place. The platform includes a self-service portal for employees and integrates with tools like Slack and WhatsApp for streamlined communication and approvals. Built for Türkiye with KVKK and SGK compliance at its core, Otto HR is also GDPR-aligned and provides a data processing agreement (DPA) to every customer.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Software Engineer at ottoHR. The Software Engineer will design, develop, and maintain back-end services that power the Otto HR platform and its AI assistant, focusing on performance, scalability, and reliability. Day-to-day responsibilities include implementing new features, enhancing existing APIs, integrating with third‑party services, and writing clean, testable code. The role also involves collaborating with product managers, designers, and other engineers to refine requirements, participate in code reviews, and contribute to architectural decisions. The Software Engineer will help improve developer tooling and workflows, monitor systems in production, and resolve issues to ensure a secure and seamless experience for customers.

Qualifications

  • Strong foundation in Computer Science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
  • Experience in Back-End Web Development, including building RESTful or GraphQL APIs and working with server-side frameworks.
  • Proficiency in Software Development and Programming, using at least one modern language (e.g., Java, C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go).
  • Hands‑on experience with Object‑Oriented Programming (OOP) and applying OOP best practices in production systems.
  • Familiarity with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), version control (Git), and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms or containerization (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes) is beneficial.
  • Ability to write tests, debug complex issues, and optimize performance in distributed systems.
  • Effective communication skills, ability to work collaboratively in a remote team, and willingness to participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience building HR, payroll, or enterprise SaaS products

title: Delivery Coördinator - Planner
description:
Automation is een innovatief engineeringbedrijf dat zich heeft gespecialiseerd in oplossingen voor ‘low voltage electrical power’ en ‘datacenter facilities’. Als kenniscentrum bieden we maatwerkoplossingen die we samen met onze klanten ontwikkelen en implementeren.

Met meer dan 80 medewerkers beschikken we over de nodige expertise en ervaring om hoogwaardige toepassingen te leveren. En we blijven groeien!

We investeren niet alleen in onze klanten, maar ook in onze medewerkers. Bij de start ontvang je een uitgebreide opleiding on-the-job. Op lange termijn zorgen we voor persoonlijke begeleiding en bieden we volop kansen om je professionele ontwikkeling voort te zetten.

Automation blijft op volle kracht verder groeien. Om dat succes door te zetten zijn we op zoek naar een bijkomende Delivery Coördinator - Planner om onze productie te ondersteunen.

Doel van de functie:
Je zorgt ervoor dat mensen en middelen zo efficiënt mogelijk in het productie- en project management proces worden ingepland en ingezet. Dit zodat Automation met de juiste kwaliteit, levertijd en kost kan produceren. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Productie Manager.

Als Delivery Coördinator - Planner ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het maken van de vertaalslag van vooruitzichten en orders naar de productie evenals het opstellen van een planning. Je coördineert deze planning en stuurt bij waar nodig. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de nauwkeurigheid en tijdigheid van deze processen en leveringen van alle aard.

  • Maandelijkse ondersteuning op een gemotiveerde en gedocumenteerde manier; het opstellen en bijhouden van een factureringsschema op basis van een gedetailleerde planning voor de komende 3 maanden.

  • De korte en lange termijn planning van de productieopdrachten en draag je er zorg voor dat de werkzaamheden van onderaannemers goed worden georganiseerd en gecoördineerd om optimale prestaties te behalen.

  • Het opstellen van een rooster waaraan de werknemers zich moeten houden.

  • In nauw overleg met verkoop aan de hand van vooruitzichten, productieorders en beschikbaarheid van materialen, grondstoffen en capaciteiten bepalen wanneer en in welke hoeveelheden halffabricaten en fabricaten moeten worden geproduceerd.

  • Samen met de productie, service en project management afdelingen ervoor zorgen dat deze planning behaald wordt. Ingrijpen bij oponthoud en waar nodig de planning bijsturen. Een actieve rol opnemen in het dagelijks multidisciplinair overleg.

Een greep uit jouw takenpakket:

  • Opstellen en bewaken van de planning; snel schakelen rekening houdende met de werkelijke beschikbaarheid van personeel en goederen.

  • De nodige informatie ter beschikking hebben om klantenleverdata te bevestigen en eventueel te updaten waar nodig. Steeds een perfect overzicht hebben van waar we staan in de productie.

  • Assisteren bij het bepalen van aantallen mensen, materialen en middelen en dit op lange en korte termijn evenals het in kaart brengen van benodigde grondstoffen, accessoires en capaciteit.

  • Productieopdrachten verwerken.

  • Contacten onderhouden met supply chain en procurement en alle anderen betrokken bij het productieproces.

  • Afstemmen met subcontractors tijdens het productieproces.

  • Monitoren van de beschikbaarheid van productietekeningen.

  • Je hebt minstens een diploma hoger onderwijs en bij voorkeur een 5-tal jaar ervaring als planner binnen een productieomgeving.

  • Je kunt vlot om met Microsoft Office en ERP-pakketten, Navision is een meerwaarde.

  • Kennis van Nederlands en/of Frans, kennis Engels is een meerwaarde.

  • Je werkt methodisch en bent sterk in plannen en organiseren.

  • Je hebt een sterk analytisch denkvermogen en bent accuraat.

  • Je beschikt over sterke communicatievaardigheden en bent een echte teampayer.

  • Je bent stressbestendig.

Wat bieden wij aan?

Je komt terecht in een bedrijf met een vlakke structuur dat in volle groei is. Dit biedt jou de kans om samen met ons mee te ontwikkelen. Je wordt omringd door ondernemende collega’s die “the extra mile” willen gaan. Op die manier voorzien we de beste service aan onze klanten en houden we onze kennis steeds up-to-date.

Uiteraard houden we ook rekening met een gezonde work-life balance. Tot slot bieden we jou een marktconform salaris aangevuld met extra legale voordelen.


Ben jij onze missende schakel?
Laat het ons weten via onderstaande knop. We kijken ernaar uit om jouw CV te ontvangen!

description:

Physical Education (PE) Coach – Sports Development & Athletics (Grades 3–9)
Location: Leesburg
Position Type: Full-Time
School: First Trinity Academy

First Trinity Academy is a private school focused on academic excellence, leadership, character development, and well-rounded student growth. Through small class sizes and meaningful student engagement, we strive to build confident, disciplined, and healthy young leaders both inside and outside the classroom.

We are seeking an energetic, inspiring, and highly engaging Physical Education Coach to teach students in grades 3 through 9.

The ideal candidate is passionate about youth athletics and capable of teaching both the theory and practical application of sports. This coach should know how to develop students’ athletic skills, teamwork, confidence, sportsmanship, discipline, and game understanding through structured instruction and active participation.

This role includes teaching students how to properly play and understand sports such as:
  • Basketball
  • Volleyball
  • Soccer
  • Flag Football
The coach will also organize and lead school athletic activities and special events, including a large annual Field Day/Sports Day event where families can attend and watch students demonstrate their skills and participate in organized competitions.

Responsibilities
  • Teach PE and sports instruction to grades 3–9
  • Instruct students in the rules, techniques, strategies, and skills of multiple sports
  • Teach proper athletic fundamentals including coordination, conditioning, teamwork, and sportsmanship
  • Lead structured drills, scrimmages, and skill-building exercises
  • Maintain strong classroom and gymnasium management
  • Encourage student participation, confidence, discipline, and healthy competition
  • Organize school-wide athletic events, competitions, and Field Day activities
  • Coordinate sporting activities where parents and families can attend and support students
  • Promote physical fitness, leadership, and character development
  • Ensure safety procedures and proper use of equipment at all times
  • Participate in school meetings, events, and professional development opportunities
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Physical Education, Sports Science, Education, or related field (required)
  • Florida teaching certification preferred, but not required
  • Strong knowledge of basketball, volleyball, soccer, and flag football fundamentals and coaching techniques
  • Excellent leadership and classroom management skills
  • Ability to motivate and engage elementary and middle school students
  • Strong organizational and communication skills
  • Prior coaching or athletic instruction experience preferred
Ideal Candidate
  • Passionate about youth athletics and student development
  • Highly energetic, structured, and engaging
  • Able to teach both sports theory and practical athletic skills
  • Encourages teamwork, discipline, and confidence in students
  • Strong role model with professional leadership presence
  • Strong classroom management skills
  • Creative in organizing athletic activities and student events
Compensation
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Small class sizes and supportive work environment
  • Opportunity to build and grow the school’s athletics culture and programs

title: Senior Tech Lead -DevOps
description:
We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Lead – DevOps to lead the design, delivery, and ongoing improvement of our cloud and platform infrastructure. You’ll guide DevOps engineers, partner with development and security teams, and help build reliable, secure and scalable systems that support rapid software delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive the elimination of manual toil by building fully automated CI/CD pipelines, enforcing complete Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and delivering self-service tooling that empowers developers.

  • Ensure system reliability and resilience through comprehensive observability, well-defined disaster recovery strategies (RTO/RPO), and continuous improvement via incident analysis and automated remediation.

  • Maintain a modern, secure technology stack by implementing repeatable upgrade frameworks, validating changes in production-like environments, and executing zero-downtime deployments using advanced release strategies.

  • Establish deployment standards and the “Golden Path,” embed DevSecOps best practices into all workflows, and mentor teams through strong documentation and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering roles, with at least 2–3 years in a leadership capacity.

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).

  • Deep knowledge of CI/CD systems and automation frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience with container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).

  • Proven experience implementing observability solutions (monitoring, logging, tracing).

  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience with security best practices in cloud-native environments.

description:
About Legacy Partners:
Legacy Partners is a privately held real estate firm that owns, develops, and manages multifamily communities throughout the United States. Since 1968, we have developed more than 78,000 apartment homes and have worked with some of the world’s largest financial institutions, life insurance companies, and real estate companies. In addition to development, Legacy Partners provides management services for our own portfolio and other owners. Combined, we manage a portfolio of over 50 multifamily communities with more than 12,000 apartment homes with a gross value in excess of $3 billion.
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Job Summary:
Responsible, under the supervision of the Business Manager or Leasing Manager, for marketing, leasing, and pre-leasing apartment homes. Coordinate Move-In information forms and resolve resident issues/concerns as necessary. This is an on-site, full-time position with a Thursday through Monday schedule.
Key Responsibilities:

Leasing & Tours –Greet and assist prospective residents. Give property tours and match prospects with available units. Explain lease terms and guide applicants through the leasing process.
Marketing & Outreach – Support marketing efforts and outreach campaigns. Stay informed on local amenities and competitor properties. Promote community features and maintain the online reputation.
Resident Relations – Provide great customer service and help resolve resident concerns. Assist with move-ins, welcome new residents, and deliver notices. Support resident events and communication efforts.
Administrative Support – Process applications, collect deposits, and maintain accurate records. Keep lease files organized and handle daily phone/email traffic. Maintain office supplies and general organization.
Property Upkeep – Inspect apartments and community areas regularly. Report maintenance or safety issues and submit service requests.
Team Collaboration – Work with the team to meet leasing goals and support daily operations. Contribute to a positive, professional office environment.

This job description is not intended to be all–inclusive, and the employee will also perform other reasonably related business duties as assigned by the immediate supervisor and other management as required. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Additional Compensation:
Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range, including business requirements, prior experience, current skills, and geographical location.
In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a bi-weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Summary of Benefits*:

Comprehensive Health Coverage—Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, group life, and accidental death and dismemberment insurance. A Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer match is available for those enrolled in medical coverage. Benefits are offered for employees with a regular work schedule of 30+ hours per week.
Paid Sick Leave – 1 hour accrued per 30 hours worked (max 120 hours).
Vacation Time – Accrued based on hours worked (up to 120 hours in the first five years), with additional accrual over time.
10 Paid Holidays Per Year
Paid Jury Duty & Bereavement Leave
401(k) with Company Match – Eligible after 90 days of employment with employer contribution.
Special Perks & Recognition – Anniversary rewards and sail-away days.
A housing discount (generally 20%) may be available when living and working at the same site and when there is an open slot—the number of discounts is limited. A New Hire must meet rental qualifications to rent.

title: Cloud Data Engineer
description:
About the Team

DoorDash is looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our growing Tax Data Mart team. This role will be a key contributor to the team and will be responsible for building and operating the data pipelines and infrastructure that power analytics and decision-making across the company.

As DoorDash continues to grow its global footprint across multiple business lines, we are looking for a candidate with experience designing and maintaining scalable data systems. This person will support and grow our unique community via your blend of engineering, technology, and process improvement experience.

About the Role

You will be reporting to the Manager of Tax Data Mart, and play an integral role in DoorDash's data function, owning the processes for ingesting, transforming, and controlling our data, ensuring accuracy, and making it available to analytics and business users.

As a member of this team, you will lead the design, implementation, and operation of data pipelines and related processes to support the Company's exponential growth.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that serve data across the company
  • Develop and optimize data models and warehouse structures to support analytics and reporting
  • Participate in new business initiatives and identify their impact on existing data system(s) and processes.
  • Work closely with Analytics, Data Science, and business partners in the development and validation of new data sources.
  • Identify and document business, functional and technical requirements to support new business initiatives and to enhance existing system functionality.
  • Leverage AI & AI assisted tooling to build and automate recurring data tasks & pipelines.
  • Monitor data quality, reliability, and observability, and resolve data-related issues for our internal business partners.
  • Participate in defining the Company's data tooling needs, including the maintenance of existing systems.
  • Prepare documentation related to our data systems and processes.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with engineers and analysts across the team.

We're excited about you because...

  • You have 5+ years of experience in a data engineering or similar role.
  • Experience using Data Build Tool (DBT) or a similar product to manage data flows.
  • Experience using Claude, Cursor and similar AI tools.
  • You are an expert at using SQL with experience using Snowflake.
  • Proficiency in Python (or a comparable language) for building data pipelines.
  • Experience with modern data stack and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Spark, or Kafka.
  • You have strong attention to detail and analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • You're an independently motivated person with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work independently.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Project management experience, including creation of project plans, milestones, and due dates.
  • Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related degree.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users - from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect (107-10SARC-01)
description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1–4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2–3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

    • Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome.

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS MAP phases: Assess, Mobilize, and Migrate & Modernize.

  • Migrations from VMware, on-premises data centers, Azure or GCP.

  • Experience with AI-assisted migration and modernization tooling, such as AWS Transform.

  • AWS Specialty certifications, such as Security or Advanced Networking.

Final Details

Remote

Contractor USD Full Time ( US time zone with a few hours of overlap with CET )

Start date : ASAP

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote, Vietnam)
description:
Who We Are & How We Work

We're on a mission to make employment easier and more valuable for everyone. Our Employment Operating System brings hiring, HR, payroll and benefits into one platform, supporting over 350,000 businesses and 2.5 million employees worldwide.

We're a Mission First, Remote First and AI First company, guided by our values and a commitment to high performance.

Our Engineering team follows a one problem, one engineer approach. With AI coding agents at the core of how we build, Engineers own problems end-to-end, from understanding customer needs and designing solutions to delivering them into production. We start with the smallest working solution and continuously improve it, giving Engineers the autonomy to make decisions and create meaningful product impact.

The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll build and scale the systems behind our Employment Operating System, solving complex engineering challenges that impact millions of users.

We're looking for someone who combines strong backend expertise, product thinking and independent problem-solving, while making a broader impact through technical leadership, collaboration and helping the team succeed.

What you'll do:

  • Own complex problems end-to-end, from understanding customer needs and designing solutions to development, testing and production deployment.
  • Build and scale reliable backend services, RESTful APIs and integrations.
  • Drive technical decisions, balancing performance, scalability, maintainability and product impact.
  • Leverage AI coding agents to accelerate delivery while maintaining high engineering standards.
  • Elevate your team's performance by influencing technical decisions, sharing expertise, mentoring Engineers and continuously improving engineering practices.
  • Collaborate across Product and Engineering, challenge assumptions and help your squad deliver better product outcomes..

What We're Looking For

  • Senior-level engineering expertise, typically 7+ years in software development, with proven experience delivering complex solutions in production.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one backend language, such as Ruby, Python, Java, PHP or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Solid understanding of backend architecture, RESTful APIs, databases, system design and automated testing.
  • Strong product mindset and technical judgement, with the ability to independently solve ambiguous problems and make pragmatic trade-offs.
  • Team-level impact, with a proven ability to influence technical decisions, raise engineering standards and help other Engineers grow.
  • An AI-first mindset, with experience or a strong willingness to use AI coding agents to improve software delivery.
  • Good English communication skills, a proactive approach and the ability to thrive in a global, remote-first team.

We primarily build our applications using Ruby. Ruby experience isn't required, and we'll support you in developing the necessary skills when you join.

What we can offer

At Employment Hero, we don't just talk about a better way to work. We live it.

Joining Employment Hero means you'll:

  • Work in a remote-first environment, giving you the autonomy to do your best work while delivering meaningful outcomes.
  • Be trusted to own your work, make decisions, and have a real impact from day one.
  • Access cutting-edge AI tools and technology that help you move faster, think bigger, and amplify your expertise.
  • Surround yourself with ambitious, high-performing teammates who will challenge, support and inspire you to do the best work of your career.
  • Own ESOP (Employee Share Options) in one of the world's fastest-growing technology companies, so you can share in the value you help create.
  • Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including generous parental leave, subsidised egg freezing, a home office allowance, and outstanding learning and development opportunities to support your growth.
  • Connect with colleagues from around the world at our Annual Global Gathering. We've celebrated together in Thailand, Vietnam, Bali and Dubai, and can't wait to meet in the Gold Coast, Australia, in September 2026.

Privacy and AI Notices

  • We’re AI-first, so may use AI tools to review your applications and support our interviewing and hiring process. They help us cut the noise, surface great talent fast and make sure every candidate gets a fair, consistent experience. These tools do not replace human judgment and the final hiring decision sits with our team.
  • We verify candidate identity and location as part of our hiring process.
  • At Employment Hero, we are committed to safeguarding the privacy of your application data. By applying to this role, you acknowledge our Applicant Privacy Policy made available here: employmenthero.com/legals/applicant-policy/.

Ellie Mental Health in St. Charles is growing, and we're looking for compassionate, motivated Licensed and Provisionally Licensed Mental Health Therapists to join our outpatient team!

We welcome LCSWs, LCPCs, LMFTs, LPCs, and LSWs who are passionate about helping individuals and families improve their mental health and overall well-being. Bilingual Spanish-English clinicians are especially encouraged to apply, although bilingual proficiency is not required.

At Ellie, we believe therapists do their best work when they feel supported. Our clinic is designed to reduce administrative burdens, encourage clinical autonomy, and provide the flexibility, resources, and collaboration clinicians need to focus on what matters most—providing exceptional client care.

We believe happy therapists provide better therapy!

We welcome clinicians who enjoy working with children, adolescents, adults, couples, and families, and we encourage therapists to build caseloads that align with their clinical interests and areas of expertise.

Why Ellie Mental Health?
We understand the importance of work-life balance, professional growth, and feeling valued as a clinician. That's why we offer:
  • Competitive compensation with a base pay and commission structure
  • Paid administrative time
  • Flexible scheduling options
  • Clinical supervision and support for provisionally licensed therapists
  • Dedicated administrative, scheduling, and billing support
  • Opportunities to develop clinical specialties, groups, and programs
  • Collaborative team environment with regular clinical consultation
  • Professional development and advancement opportunities
  • A welcoming, inclusive workplace that values individuality and creativity
  • Less administrative stress and more time to focus on your clients

  • Provide evidence-based individual, couples, and/or family therapy based on clinical training and expertise.
  • Develop, implement, and regularly review individualized treatment plans.
  • Maintain timely, accurate clinical documentation, including progress notes, treatment plans, and assessments.
  • Provide culturally responsive, trauma-informed, and client-centered care.
  • Collaborate with families, schools, medical providers, and other professionals when clinically appropriate and authorized.
  • Participate in team meetings, clinical consultation, supervision, and professional development opportunities.
  • Maintain ethical and professional standards consistent with Illinois licensing requirements and clinic policies.
  • Full-time clinicians are expected to maintain an average of 25 completed client sessions per week.
Required Qualifications
  • Master's degree in Social Work, Counseling, Marriage and Family Therapy, or a related behavioral health field from an accredited institution.
  • Active Illinois professional license, including LCSW, LCPC, LMFT, LPC, or LSW.
  • Knowledge of clinical assessments, treatment planning, and evidence-based therapeutic interventions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation.
  • Commitment to professional ethics, confidentiality, and appropriate clinical boundaries.
  • Comfort working with diverse populations and a variety of presenting concerns.
  • Ability to use an Electronic Health Record (EHR) system.
  • A collaborative, compassionate approach to client care and teamwork.
Preferred Qualifications
The following are preferred but not required:
  • Bilingual proficiency in Spanish and English
  • Experience working with children, adolescents, adults, couples, and/or families
  • Experience treating anxiety, depression, trauma, behavioral concerns, or substance use disorders
  • Training in evidence-based and trauma-informed treatment approaches
  • Previous outpatient or community mental health experience
  • Experience providing insurance-based mental health services
We welcome clinicians with a variety of backgrounds, specialties, and experience levels.

Full-Time Benefits
Eligible full-time employees enjoy:

  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays, including your birthday!
  • Paid continuing education time
  • Free access to Ellie's CEU platform
  • Clinical supervision and professional development
  • Opportunities for advancement and leadership
  • Team-building events, supportive colleagues, and Ellie swag!
Be Part of Something Different!

Ellie Mental Health was founded by clinicians who wanted to make mental health care more accessible while creating a better workplace for therapists.

Our core values—Authenticity, Humor, Compassion, Creativity, Acceptance, and Determination—aren't just words. They shape how we support our clients, collaborate with one another, and build a positive workplace culture.

Whether you're an experienced clinician or a provisionally licensed therapist looking to grow your skills, we want you to feel supported, valued, and excited about the work you do.

If you're looking for an outpatient therapy position where you can grow professionally, develop a caseload that reflects your interests, and be part of a genuinely supportive team, we'd love to connect with you.

Bilingual Spanish-English skills are a plus, but all qualified therapists are encouraged to apply!

Apply today and join the Ellie Mental Health – St. Charles team!

Data Center Construction Cleaning Foreman

Georgia Cleaning Pros is seeking an experienced and dependable Data Center Construction Cleaning Foreman to lead cleaning crews and oversee daily cleaning operations on an active data center construction site.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise construction cleaning crews and assign daily work areas

  • Conduct pre-shift safety meetings and communicate production goals

  • Oversee rough, progressive, final and turnover cleaning

  • Ensure sensitive data center areas remain clean and free of dust, debris and contaminants

  • Coordinate cleaning activities around electrical, mechanical, server-room and other critical infrastructure installations

  • Work closely with project managers, superintendents and other trades

  • Inspect completed areas for quality and readiness for client turnover

  • Monitor employee attendance, hours, productivity and performance

  • Enforce site safety rules, PPE requirements and access-control procedures

  • Ensure employees follow approved cleaning methods and use appropriate chemicals and equipment

  • Maintain cleaning tools, equipment and supply inventory

  • Train new employees on safety, quality and data center cleanliness requirements

  • Knowledge of construction cleaning phases and final-turnover standards

  • Ability to work around sensitive electrical and mechanical equipment

  • Strong leadership, communication and organizational skills

  • Ability to read work-area maps, follow schedules and document completed work

  • Dependable attendance and reliable transportation

  • Ability to lift at least 50 pounds and stand, walk, bend and climb stairs for extended periods

  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening

  • Ability to meet all project badging and security requirements
